articles.title_en: Insights into multiscale damage mechanisms in cementitious materials under thermal cycling: the role of moisture behavior
articles.title_cn: 热循环作用下水泥基材料多尺度损伤机制研究：水分行为的作用
articles.abstract_en: Cementitious materials can deteriorate under thermal cycling (TC) above the freezing point even though no ice-related bulk phase transition occurs, which points to moisture behavior as a likely driver of damage, yet its specific contribution remains unclear. To isolate this contribution, we developed a field-temperature-referenced accelerated TC regime (5–45 °C, 3 h/cycle) and applied it to white Portland cement (WPC) paste preconditioned to controlled internal relative humidity (RH) levels of 10–99% and tested under either sealed or free-exchange boundary conditions, so that the internal moisture state and boundary-controlled moisture exchange could be separated. Under sealed conditions, UPV loss grew with internal RH, from 3.89% (S10) to 8.62% (S99), despite negligible net mass change. Standardized multiscale indicators revealed an RH-dependent transition in the governing mechanism: drier specimens were controlled by capillary suction and pore coarsening, whereas wetter specimens underwent cyclic moisture redistribution, accumulated short-T2 water (interlayer and gel water), and developed localized microcracking within a densifying matrix. 1H NMR confirmed that this redistribution was only partly reversible, leaving a residual shift toward short-T2 components, and the calculated calcium-silicate-hydrate (C-S-H) interlayer spacing evolved toward about 0.76 nm regardless of the initial state. Allowing free moisture exchange changed the mechanism rather than merely intensifying it: F99 showed the largest UPV loss (19.4%), together with stronger crack connectivity, pronounced strain localization (μεxx = −2.25, μεyy = −4.76), and intensified carbonation, signaling a coupled moisture transport–carbonation–fracture pathway. On this basis, a tri-component thermo-hygro damage model was formulated to apportion UPV-based deterioration among intrinsic thermal fatigue, RH-dependent amplification, and boundary-controlled moisture exchange. The results establish, at the matrix scale, that internal moisture state and boundary exchange—not net drying—govern the severity and the mode of TC-induced damage in cement paste.
articles.abstract_cn: 水泥基材料在冰点以上的热循环（TC）作用下会发生劣化，即使没有发生与冰相关的体相转变，这表明水分行为可能是损伤的驱动因素，但其具体贡献仍不清楚。为分离这一贡献，我们开发了一种场温度参考的加速热循环制度（5-45 °C，3 小时/循环），并将其应用于预 conditioning 至受控内部相对湿度（RH）水平（10-99%）的白硅酸盐水泥（WPC）浆体，并在密封或自由交换边界条件下进行测试，从而可以分离内部水分状态和边界控制的水分交换。在密封条件下，超声波脉冲速度（UPV）损失随内部相对湿度的增加而增加，从 3.89%（S10）到 8.62%（S99），尽管净质量变化可忽略不计。标准化的多尺度指标揭示了控制机制随相对湿度变化的转变：较干燥的试样受毛细管吸力和孔隙粗化控制，而较湿润的试样经历循环水分再分布，积累短T2水（层间水和凝胶水），并在致密化基体内发展局部微裂纹。1H NMR 证实这种再分布仅部分可逆，留下向短T2组分的残余偏移，计算得到的钙硅酸盐 hydrate（C-S-H）层间距无论初始状态如何均演化至约 0.76 nm。允许自由水分交换改变了机制而非仅仅加剧了它：F99 显示出最大的 UPV 损失（19.4%），同时具有更强的裂纹连通性、显著的应变局部化（μεxx = −2.25，μεyy = −4.76）和加剧的碳化，表明存在耦合的水分传输-碳化-断裂路径。在此基础上，建立了一个三组分热湿损伤模型，将基于 UPV 的劣化分配为固有热疲劳、相对湿度依赖的放大和边界控制的水分交换。结果在基体尺度上证实，内部水分状态和边界交换——而非净干燥——控制着水泥浆体中 TC 诱导损伤的严重程度和模式。

articles.title_en: Evaluating links between microscale mineralogy and neutral rock drainage chemistry in mine waste materials
articles.title_cn: 评估矿山废料中微尺度矿物学与中性岩石排水化学之间的联系
articles.abstract_en: Quantitative automated mineralogical analysis is commonly used in mineral exploration, processing and increasingly in mine waste management. Yet, full integration between the microscale mineralogical dynamics of mine waste materials and the evolution of (bulk) wastewater quality remains challenging, especially for complex, heterogeneous materials. We experimented with syenite and skarn waste rock in 32-week leaching experiments under oxic versus sub-oxic conditions and examined the potential controls of (modal) mineralogical composition and mineral textures on select hydrochemical features of the resulting leachate. Circumneutral leachate pH was maintained throughout all experiments, and Ca, Sr, and Mn, and bicarbonate and sulfate were the most abundant solutes mobilized through mineral dissolution. Mineralogical analyses reveal carbonates and sulfates as the most reactive phases with generally higher exposures (liberation) and significant alteration to their textural properties, particularly in experiments under oxic conditions. Descriptive statistical analyses (time series, partial correlations and principal component analyses) helped identify plausible mechanistic controls on leachate trends, e.g., elevated Ca and Mg leachate concentrations attributed to carbonate dissolution and a mobilization of Sr from celestine dissolution. This study demonstrates that automated mineralogical analyses can provide valuable mechanistic insight into selected drainage features, while highlighting the challenges of establishing robust quantitative relationships between microscale mineralogical properties and bulk wastewater quality in heterogeneous mine waste materials.
articles.abstract_cn: 定量自动化矿物学分析常用于矿产勘探、加工，并越来越多地用于矿山废料管理。然而，矿山废料材料的微尺度矿物学动态与（总体）废水质量演变之间的完全整合仍然具有挑战性，尤其是对于复杂、异质的材料。我们在32周的浸出实验中，对正长岩和矽卡岩废石在氧化与次氧化条件下进行了实验，并考察了（模态）矿物组成和矿物结构对所得浸出液特定水化学特征的潜在控制作用。所有实验中浸出液pH值保持在中性附近，通过矿物溶解 mobilized 的最丰富溶质为Ca、Sr、Mn以及碳酸氢盐和硫酸盐。矿物学分析显示，碳酸盐和硫酸盐是最具反应性的相，通常具有较高的暴露（解离）程度，并且其结构性质发生显著变化，尤其是在氧化条件下的实验中。描述性统计分析（时间序列、偏相关和主成分分析）有助于识别浸出液趋势的合理机制控制因素，例如，Ca和Mg浸出液浓度升高归因于碳酸盐溶解，而Sr的迁移来自天青石溶解。本研究证明，自动化矿物学分析可以为特定排水特征提供有价值的机制见解，同时强调了在异质矿山废料材料中建立微尺度矿物学性质与总体废水质量之间稳健定量关系的挑战。

articles.title_en: Fe(II)-doped hydrotalcite in cement systems: Structure and Cr(VI) immobilization
articles.title_cn: 水泥体系中Fe(II)掺杂水滑石：结构及Cr(VI)固定
articles.abstract_en: Fe(II)-doped hydrotalcite can form in cement systems under anoxic conditions, e.g., landfills and geological repositories, but its molecular structure and environmental function remain largely unexplored. Here, the molecular structure and Cr(VI) immobilization mechanism of Fe(II)-hydrotalcite are investigated through a combination of synchrotron-based X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) and molecular simulations. Fe(II) can substitute for Mg(II) in the hydrotalcite main layer, forming a continuous solid solution and inducing local structural distortion likely caused by differences in ionic radius and electron distribution. The incorporation of Fe(II) markedly enhances the Cr(VI) retention capacity, increasing the removal efficiency from ~10% to nearly 100%. Combined Fe and Cr K-edge XAS reveals that Cr(VI) is reduced to Cr(III), while Fe(II) is oxidized to Fe(III). The Cr(III) species are likely incorporated into a goethite-like phase. These findings provide molecular-level insight into the structure-redox-immobilization relationship of Fe(II)-hydrotalcite and offer guidance for designing cementitious materials capable of long-term retention of toxic oxyanions.
articles.abstract_cn: Fe(II)掺杂水滑石可在缺氧条件下（如垃圾填埋场和地质处置库）的水泥体系中形成，但其分子结构和环境功能在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本研究通过同步辐射X射线吸收光谱（XAS）与分子模拟相结合的方法，研究了Fe(II)-水滑石的分子结构及Cr(VI)固定机制。Fe(II)可替代水滑石主层中的Mg(II)，形成连续固溶体，并引起局部结构畸变，这可能是由离子半径和电子分布的差异所致。Fe(II)的掺入显著增强了Cr(VI)的保留能力，将去除效率从约10%提高到接近100%。Fe和Cr K边XAS联合分析表明，Cr(VI)被还原为Cr(III)，而Fe(II)被氧化为Fe(III)。Cr(III)物种可能被掺入针铁矿相中。这些发现为Fe(II)-水滑石的结构-氧化还原-固定关系提供了分子层面的见解，并为设计能够长期保留有毒含氧阴离子的胶凝材料提供了指导。

articles.title_en: Versatility of buccal myomucosal flap for secondary cleft palatal defects- our experience with 123 cases
articles.title_cn: 颊肌黏膜瓣在继发性腭裂缺损修复中的多功能性——基于123例病例的经验
articles.abstract_en: IntroductionCleft palate repair aims to restore both the anatomical and functional integrity of the palate. Despite advancements in surgical procedures, palatal fistulas continue to be a severe problem, affecting speech, swallowing, and quality of life. The. This study investigates the efficacy of buccal myomucosal flaps in closure of secondary cleft palatal defects, with an emphasis on larger anterior fistulas. Materials and methodsWe treated 123 patients with palatal fistulae using buccal myomucosal flaps from 2008 to 2023. All cases involved a two-layer closure technique using a posteriorly based buccal artery pedicle. Patients were followed up postoperatively at intervals of 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, and 12 months. Speech outcomes were assessed preoperatively and postoperatively. ResultsThe study included 62 females and 61 males with mean age 6 years 11 months. The original defects included unilateral, bilateral, and isolated cleft palates. Most fistulas (43%) were located at the anterior hard palate. Buccal flaps were taken from the right side in 64% of cases, left side in 23%, and bilaterally in 12%. The largest fistula measured 6 cm × 7 cm, and the smallest 11 mm × 18 mm. Postoperative complications were minimal, with no cases of hemorrhage, infection, or flap necrosis. Speech analysis showed significant improvement across all measures. ConclusionThe buccal myomucosal flap is a versatile and effective technique for secondary cleft palatal defect repair. It provides a reliable solution for closing fistulas and lengthening the soft palate, with minimal complications and significant improvements in speech.
articles.abstract_cn: 引言腭裂修复旨在恢复腭部的解剖和功能完整性。尽管手术技术不断进步，腭瘘仍然是一个严重问题，影响言语、吞咽和生活质量。本研究探讨颊肌黏膜瓣在关闭继发性腭裂缺损中的疗效，重点关注较大的前部瘘管。材料与方法我们于2008年至2023年间使用颊肌黏膜瓣治疗了123例腭瘘患者。所有病例均采用基于后部颊动脉蒂的两层关闭技术。患者术后分别在1周、1个月、3个月、6个月和12个月进行随访。言语结果在术前和术后进行评估。结果研究包括62名女性和61名男性，平均年龄为6岁11个月。原始缺损包括单侧、双侧和孤立性腭裂。大多数瘘管（43%%）位于前硬腭。颊瓣取自右侧的占64%%，左侧占23%%，双侧占12%。最大瘘管尺寸为6厘米×7厘米，最小为11毫米×18毫米。术后并发症极少，无出血、感染或皮瓣坏死病例。言语分析显示所有指标均有显著改善。结论颊肌黏膜瓣是修复继发性腭裂缺损的一种多功能且有效的技术。它为关闭瘘管和延长软腭提供了可靠的解决方案，并发症少，言语改善显著。

articles.title_en: Hearing is caring: Machine learning modelling for the prediction of pediatric unmet hearing health needs
The gender dimension of refugees’ integration in the labor market
articles.title_cn: 难民劳动力市场融入的性别维度
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the gender differences in labor market integration among refugees and their determinants. It focuses on a longitudinal dataset that covers the entire refugee population in Switzerland over 20 years. During the period examined, the majority of refugees came from low-income economies in Africa and Asia. The quasi-random allocation of asylum seekers across Swiss cantons, which differ in their socio-economic characteristics, provides a natural experiment to identify the effects of source country culture and the role of local initial conditions in shaping refugees’ labor-market integration trajectories. Our empirical findings show that women refugees from countries with more conservative gender norms (measured by female-to-male labor force participation ratios and fertility rates) have less favorable labor market outcomes, with these effects varying in their persistence over time. The analysis further reveals the negative role of initial unemployment and the positive role of co-ethnic networks in the cantons of arrival, with these effects varying by gender and network characteristics. Finally, local attitudes toward gender equality reduce the gender gap in labor market outcomes among refugees.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了难民劳动力市场融入中的性别差异及其决定因素。研究聚焦于一个覆盖瑞士全部难民人口、时间跨度达20年的纵向数据集。在研究期间，大多数难民来自非洲和亚洲的低收入经济体。寻求庇护者在社会经济特征各异的瑞士各州之间的准随机分配，提供了一个自然实验，用以识别来源国文化的影响以及当地初始条件在塑造难民劳动力市场融入轨迹中的作用。我们的实证研究结果表明，来自性别规范更为保守（以男女劳动力参与率之比和生育率衡量）的国家的女性难民，其劳动力市场结果较差，且这些效应在时间上的持续性有所不同。分析进一步揭示了到达州初始失业率的负面作用以及同族网络的正面作用，这些效应因性别和网络特征而异。最后，当地对性别平等的态度缩小了难民劳动力市场结果中的性别差距。

articles.title_en: A study on the adsorption and dispersion capability of VPEG-PCEs with different structures on cement containing montmorillonite
articles.title_cn: 不同结构VPEG-PCEs对含蒙脱土水泥的吸附与分散性能研究
articles.abstract_en: Polycarboxylate ether (PCE) superplasticizer exhibits excellent dispersion and water-reducing capability, but its poor tolerance to montmorillonite (MMT) limits the application. This paper synthesized PCEs with multi-branches structure and their molecular structures were characterized by Gel permeation chromatography (GPC), Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), 1H-nuclear magnetic resonance (1H-NMR) spectroscopy and specific charge density. The adsorption behaviors of the synthesized PCEs on cement and MMT were investigated. The time-dependent flowability of the paste with these PCEs were measured, and the hydration of cement were examined. Based on that, the interaction mechanisms between these PCEs and MMT were revealed. Results show that the novel PCEs exhibit stronger dispersion capability in cement containing MMT system and have the lower relative flowability loss values than that of comb-like PCE (VPCE). Interestingly, the performance of the PCE grafted polyethylene glycol diacrylate (PPCE) shows higher dependence on the content of MMT. At a low MMT content, it exhibits stronger tolerance to MMT than the PCE with N'N methylene bisacrylamide monomer (MPCE), but the flowability of paste significantly decreases with the increase of MMT.
articles.abstract_cn: 聚羧酸醚（PCE）高效减水剂表现出优异的分散和减水能力，但其对蒙脱土（MMT）的耐受性较差，限制了其应用。本文合成了多支链结构的PCEs，并通过凝胶渗透色谱（GPC）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）、1H-核磁共振（1H-NMR）光谱和比电荷密度对其分子结构进行了表征。研究了合成的PCEs在水泥和MMT上的吸附行为。测量了含这些PCEs浆体的随时间变化的流动性，并考察了水泥的水化过程。在此基础上，揭示了这些PCEs与MMT之间的相互作用机制。结果表明，新型PCEs在含MMT水泥体系中表现出更强的分散能力，且相对流动性损失值低于梳形PCE（VPCE）。有趣的是，接枝聚乙二醇二丙烯酸酯的PCE（PPCE）的性能对MMT含量表现出更高的依赖性。在低MMT含量下，其对MMT的耐受性强于含N'N亚甲基双丙烯酰胺单体的PCE（MPCE），但随着MMT含量的增加，浆体的流动性显著下降。

articles.title_en: In-situ polymerization-induced thixotropy of cement paste under shear histories: A theoretical model
articles.title_cn: 剪切历史下原位聚合诱导水泥浆体触变性的理论模型
articles.abstract_en: In-situ polymerization modified cement paste (IPC) offers significant potential for applications such as anti-washout concrete and 3D concrete printing (3DCP), owing to its uniquely enhanced rheological properties. However, the thixotropic behavior of IPC following different shear histories remains unclear. Here, we establish a theoretical model to depict the in-situ polymerization-induced thixotropy of IPC under various shear histories and reveal the underlying physiochemical mechanism. Rheological measurements indicate that the thixotropic structural build-up of IPC decreases with increasing shear duration, consistent with the slowed re-aggregation of cement flocs observed microscopically. We found that thixotropic behavior of IPC is predominantly governed by polymer-bridging interactions, and therefore established a theoretical model based on the surface coverage ( θ ) of adsorbed polymers. When θ < θ cri , the interparticle forces exhibit only minor changes with larger θ , indicating that the monolayer adsorption ( θ cri ≅ 1) of in-situ formed sodium polyacrylate (PAAS) contributes minimally to the thixotropic structuration rate ( A thix ) as monolayer adsorption is insufficient to establish polymer bridging. Once θ > θ cri , multilayer adsorption emerges and strengthens interparticle forces through the formation of polymer bridges, thereby markedly increasing A thix . As θ approaches θ sat , polymer adsorption reaches saturation at approximately two layers of in-situ formed PAAS ( θ sat ≅ 2), leading to a gradual decline in A thix until it completely diminishes at θ sat . For a specific system, therefore, shear history determines the initial surface coverage ( θ ini ) and the potential for polymerization ( β ) during the resting period, influencing subsequent polymer adsorption and thus the thixotropic behavior of IPC. Our findings define a mechanism of in-situ polymerization-induced thixotropic structuration, paving the way for investigations into how rheological properties of IPC evolve across various applications under different shear histories.
articles.abstract_cn: 原位聚合改性水泥浆体（IPC）因其独特增强的流变性能，在抗冲刷混凝土和3D混凝土打印（3DCP）等应用中具有显著潜力。然而，不同剪切历史后IPC的触变行为仍不清楚。在此，我们建立了一个理论模型来描述不同剪切历史下原位聚合诱导的IPC触变性，并揭示其潜在的物理化学机制。流变测量表明，IPC的触变结构建立随剪切持续时间的增加而降低，这与微观观察到的水泥絮凝体再聚集减慢一致。我们发现IPC的触变行为主要由聚合物桥接相互作用控制，因此基于吸附聚合物的表面覆盖率（θ）建立了理论模型。当θ < θ_cri时，颗粒间力随θ增大仅发生微小变化，表明原位形成的聚丙烯酸钠（PAAS）的单层吸附（θ_cri ≅ 1）对触变结构化速率（A_thix）贡献极小，因为单层吸附不足以建立聚合物桥接。一旦θ > θ_cri，多层吸附出现并通过形成聚合物桥增强颗粒间力，从而显著增加A_thix。当θ接近θ_sat时，聚合物吸附达到饱和，约为两层原位形成的PAAS（θ_sat ≅ 2），导致A_thix逐渐下降直至在θ_sat时完全消失。因此，对于特定体系，剪切历史决定了静置期间的初始表面覆盖率（θ_ini）和聚合潜力（β），影响后续聚合物吸附，从而影响IPC的触变行为。我们的发现定义了原位聚合诱导触变结构化的机制，为研究不同剪切历史下IPC流变性能在各种应用中的演变铺平了道路。

articles.title_en: Further insight into the effect of silanes with different molecular structures on cement hydration
articles.title_cn: 不同分子结构硅烷对水泥水化影响的进一步研究
articles.abstract_en: Effect of three types of silanes with the increased number of amino groups (n-dodecyl triethoxysilane (DTES), aminopropyltriethoxysilane (APTES), 2-aminoethyl-3-aminopropyl trimethoxysilane (AEAPTMS)) on cement hydration was investigated by means of calorimetry, ICP-OES, TOC analysis, and DLS measurement. It is found that an increased number of amino groups in the silane molecule can lead to a strong retardation effect on cement hydration. Further analysis indicates that this retardation effect is not primarily caused by the hindrance to clinker dissolution or by the prevention of nuclei formation, but by the inhibition of the growth of hydration products. The added aminosilanes can be strongly adsorbed on the newly formed C-S-H nuclei and complex with the free calcium ions in the pore solution. The adsorption amount and the amount of complexed calcium ions of silane increase with the number of amino groups in the molecular structure. Both of them could prevent the further growth of hydration products and eventually retard cement hydration.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过量热法、ICP-OES、TOC分析和DLS测量，研究了三种氨基数量增加的硅烷（正十二烷基三乙氧基硅烷（DTES）、氨丙基三乙氧基硅烷（APTES）、[2]-氨乙基-[3]-氨丙基三甲氧基硅烷（AEAPTMS））对水泥水化的影响。研究发现，硅烷分子中氨基数量的增加可导致对水泥水化的强烈延缓作用。进一步分析表明，这种延缓作用并非主要由阻碍熟料溶解或阻止晶核形成所致，而是通过抑制水化产物的生长。添加的氨基硅烷能强烈吸附在新形成的C-S-H晶核上，并与孔隙溶液中的游离钙离子络合。硅烷的吸附量和络合钙离子的量随分子结构中氨基数量的增加而增加。这两者都能阻止水化产物的进一步生长，最终延缓水泥水化。
