articles.abstract_en: Apatite minerals and their synthetic analogs are becoming increasingly important in the rare-earth element (REE) industry. In this study, a Ce-bearing analog of lead apatite – pyromorphite Pb5(PO4)3Cl – was synthesized and its dissolution was experimentally examined over a wide temperature range, to evaluate its solubility and potential in REE recovery. We demonstrate that precipitation of pyromorphite from aqueous solution in the presence of Ce results in Ce incorporation into the structure via heterovalent substitution coupled with Na, yielding Pb4.17(Ce0.5Na0.16)(PO4)3Cl. Dissolution experiments were conducted at 5, 15, 21, 40 and 70 °C for 32 days open to the air. Solubility increases with temperature for both the pure and Ce-substituted phase. Cerium substitution in pyromorphite lowers the apparent solubility product indicating thermodynamically driven preferential incorporation of Ce into its structure. Similar to REE-rich Ca-apatite, the Ce-doped pyromorphite dissolves incongruently with precipitation of secondary Ce-phosphate phases: CePO4·0.6H2O and Ce2Pb3(PO4)4·nH2O. These phases become more abundant at elevated temperatures, reflecting their retrograde solubility typical of hydrated REE-phosphates. Nevertheless, their total abundance remains below 10 vol%. The apparent solubility constants K sp,app,25 °C calculated for the dissolution reactions Pb5(PO4)3Cl(s) ⇌ 5 Pb2+ + 3PO4 3− + Cl− and Pb4.17(Ce0.5Na0.16)(PO4)3Cl(s) ⇌ 4.17 Pb2+ + 0.16Na+ + 0.5Ce3+ + 3PO4 3− + Cl− are 10−79.98±1.72 and 10−80.34±1.16, respectively. Both constants increase with increasing temperature. These results provide new quantitative constraints on REE beneficiation strategies that rely on the precipitation of REE-substituted Pb-apatite analogs.
articles.abstract_cn: 磷灰石矿物及其合成类似物在稀土元素 (REE) 行业中变得越来越重要。在本研究中，合成了铅磷灰石的含 Ce 类似物——焦氯铅矿 Pb5(PO4)3Cl，并在较宽的温度范围内通过实验检查了其溶解情况，以评估其溶解度和 REE 回收潜力。我们证明，在存在 Ce 的情况下，叶氯矿从水溶液中沉淀出来，导致 Ce 通过与 Na 偶联的异价取代结合到结构中，产生 Pb4.17(Ce0.5Na0.16)(PO4)3Cl。溶解实验在 5、15、21、40 和 70 °C 下，在空气中开放 32 天进行。纯相和 Ce 取代相的溶解度都随着温度的升高而增加。叶氯矿中的铈取代降低了表观溶度积，表明热力学驱动的 Ce 优先掺入其结构中。与富含 REE 的钙磷灰石类似，Ce 掺杂的磷氯铅矿的溶解与次生 Ce-磷酸盐相的沉淀不一致：CePO4·0.6H2O 和 Ce2Pb3(PO4)4·nH2O。这些相在高温下变得更加丰富，反映了它们典型的水合稀土磷酸盐的逆溶解度。然而，它们的总丰度仍然低于 10 vol%。表观溶解度常数 K sp,app,25 °C 计算溶解反应 Pb5(PO4)3Cl(s) ⇌ 5 Pb2+ + 3PO4 3− + Cl− 和Pb4.17(Ce0.5Na0.16)(PO4)3Cl(s) ⇌ 4.17 Pb2+ + 0.16Na+ + 0.5Ce3+ + 3PO4 3− + Cl− 为分别为10-79.98±1.72和10-80.34±1.16。两个常数都随着温度的升高而增加。这些结果为依赖于 REE 取代的铅磷灰石类似物沉淀的 REE 选矿策略提供了新的定量限制。

articles.title_en: Quartz geochemistry and H–O isotopic signatures of the Mufushan granite-pegmatite system, South China: Implications for magmatic evolution, fluid mixing, and rare metal metallogenesis
articles.title_cn: 华南幕阜山花岗岩-伟晶岩体系的石英地球化学与H-O同位素特征：对岩浆演化、流体混合和稀有金属成矿的指示
articles.abstract_en: The Mufushan granite-pegmatite system in South China is a world-class LCT rare-metal province that preserves a well-defined record of magmatic-hydrothermal evolution. Previous studies have primarily focused on the geochronology of granites and pegmatites, the occurrence of rare metals, and the sources of ore-forming fluids. However, the genetic mechanisms of pegmatite deposits remain debated, and the prolonged history of fluid evolution in the region is still poorly constrained. This study employs femtosecond LA-ICP-MS and stable isotope techniques to characterize quartz trace element geochemistry and H–O isotopic compositions from eight granitic units of the Mufushan complex. We aim to reconstruct the petrogenesis, fluid evolution, and rare-metal mineralization from the Late Jurassic to Early Cretaceous. Quartz compositions reveal a progressive transition in substitution mechanisms: from Al3++Li+ → Si4+ during the granitic stage to Al3++Na+ → Si4+ in the pegmatitic stage. A coupled B3++P5+ → 2Si4+ substitution remained active throughout the magmatic evolution, with minimal interference from Al-bearing species. Within the framework of pegmatite genetic classification, elemental discrimination plots (Li, Al, Ge, Ti) and H–O isotopic characteristics (δD: −88.9∼-58.3‰, δ18O: 9.38∼12.14‰) suggest a hybrid petrogenetic model involving both magmatic differentiation and crustal anatexis for the Mufushan pluton. Mineralogical zonation, decreasing crystallization temperatures, and coherent trace element trends are consistent with a fractional crystallization model; however, distinct trace element patterns in muscovite granite and albite pegmatite (the weak correlation between Ge and Ti) indicate an additional contribution from crustal sources. Quartz Ge-Al-Ti-Rb content predominantly plot within the deep anatectic pegmatite (DPA) field, whereas the most evolved rocks (potassium feldspar-quartz pegmatite) trend toward residual melt granitic (RMG) signatures, further supporting a hybrid petrogenetic model. Integrating quartz thermometry with trace element data reveals a three-stage fluid evolution: (1) a granite stage recording initial fluid-rock interaction; (2) a pegmatite stage exhibiting high-temperature melt-fluid interaction, anomalous temperature increases, and enrichment of specific trace elements (B, Al, P, Na) in albite pegmatite; and (3) a poltassium feldspar-quartz pegmatite stage representing the most evolved, oxidizing end-member of the system (δCe = 0.001-0.82). Rare metal enrichment is closely associated with late-stage processes, particularly in two-mica granites and potassium feldspar-rich pegmatites. Diagnostic trace element thresholds identify highly evolved phases as key geochemical vectors for Li and B mineralization. These findings establish a hybrid petrogenetic model and highlight the metallogenic significance of late-stage evolution in orogenic LCT pegmatite systems globally.
articles.abstract_cn: 华南幕阜山花岗岩-伟晶岩体系是世界级的LCT稀有金属省，保存了清晰的岩浆-热液演化记录。以往研究主要集中于花岗岩和伟晶岩的地质年代学、稀有金属赋存状态及成矿流体来源。然而，伟晶岩矿床的成因机制仍存在争议，该地区长期的流体演化历史仍缺乏约束。本研究采用飞秒LA-ICP-MS和稳定同位素技术，表征了幕阜山杂岩体八个花岗岩单元的石英微量元素地球化学和H-O同位素组成。我们旨在重建从晚侏罗世到早白垩世的岩石成因、流体演化和稀有金属矿化过程。石英组成揭示了替代机制的渐进转变：从花岗岩阶段的Al3++Li+ → Si4+ 转变为伟晶岩阶段的Al3++Na+ → Si4+。耦合的B3++P5+ → 2Si4+替代在整个岩浆演化过程中持续活跃，且受含铝物种的干扰极小。在伟晶岩成因分类框架内，元素判别图（Li、Al、Ge、Ti）和H-O同位素特征（δD：−88.9∼-58.3‰，δ18O：9.38∼12.14‰）表明幕阜山岩体存在岩浆分异和地壳深熔的混合成因模型。矿物分带、结晶温度降低和一致的微量元素趋势与分离结晶模型相符；然而，白云母花岗岩和钠长石伟晶岩中不同的微量元素模式（Ge与Ti的弱相关性）指示了地壳来源的额外贡献。石英Ge-Al-Ti-Rb含量主要落在深部深熔伟晶岩（DPA）区域，而最演化岩石（钾长石-石英伟晶岩）趋向残余熔体花岗岩（RMG）特征，进一步支持混合成因模型。结合石英温度计和微量元素数据，揭示了三个阶段流体演化：（1）花岗岩阶段记录了初始流体-岩石相互作用；（2）伟晶岩阶段表现出高温熔体-流体相互作用、异常温度升高以及钠长石伟晶岩中特定微量元素（B、Al、P、Na）的富集；（3）钾长石-石英伟晶岩阶段代表了体系中最演化、氧化性最强的端元（δCe = 0.001-0.82）。稀有金属富集与晚期过程密切相关，尤其是在二云母花岗岩和富钾长石伟晶岩中。诊断性微量元素阈值识别出高演化相作为Li和B矿化的关键地球化学指示标志。这些发现建立了混合成因模型，并强调了晚期演化在全球造山型LCT伟晶岩体系中的成矿意义。

articles.title_en: The effects of phosphorus and fluorine doping on ternesite: Sintering behavior, high-temperature reaction kinetics and hydration properties
articles.title_cn: 磷和氟掺杂对硫硅酸钙的影响：烧结行为、高温反应动力学和水化性能
articles.abstract_en: Ternesite meets the development needs of contemporary cement industry as a low-carbon emission cement mineral. This study investigates the effects of phosphorus (P) and fluorine (F) doping on the sintering process of ternesite, revealing the kinetic mechanisms of its formation and decomposition, and exploring the regulatory role of doping on hydration behavior. The results indicated that P and F doping lowered the formation temperature of ternesite, while P doping also improved its thermal stability. The highest content of ternesite in P and F doped samples was achieved at 1150 °C for 8–12 h (90.15% and 91.35%), while the undoped samples (86.6%) was at 1200 °C for 8 h. Doping did not significantly alter the morphology of ternesite, only affected the grain size. The kinetic analysis showed that the initial formation of ternesite was influenced by diffusion control and interface chemical reaction control, while the middle and later stages and decomposition processes were dominated by diffusion control. Among them, the formation process involved the migration and diffusion of Ca2+ and SO42− through the intermediate region towards the center of SiO2 particles, while the decomposition reaction was mainly controlled by the growth of C2S and the diffusion rate of Ca2+. Ternesite had potential hydration activity, but P and F doping inhibited early activity. It was worth noting that the higher chemically combined water content in the middle and later stages of P-doped samples reflected significant hydration potential, with a paste compressive strength of 16.6 MPa at 180 d. The study of the reaction mechanism and kinetics of the ternesite minerals can provide guidance for the production and application of low-carbon cement.
articles.abstract_cn: 硫硅酸钙作为一种低碳排放的水泥矿物，满足了当代水泥工业的发展需求。本研究探讨了磷（P）和氟（F）掺杂对硫硅酸钙烧结过程的影响，揭示了其形成与分解的动力学机制，并探索了掺杂对水化行为的调控作用。结果表明，P和F掺杂降低了硫硅酸钙的形成温度，而P掺杂还提高了其热稳定性。P和F掺杂样品中硫硅酸钙的最高含量在1150 °C下保温8-12 h时达到（90.15%和91.35%），而未掺杂样品（86.6%）则在1200 °C下保温8 h时达到。掺杂并未显著改变硫硅酸钙的形貌，仅影响了晶粒尺寸。动力学分析表明，硫硅酸钙的初始形成受扩散控制和界面化学反应控制的影响，而中后期及分解过程则以扩散控制为主。其中，形成过程涉及Ca2+和SO42−通过中间区域向SiO2颗粒中心迁移和扩散，而分解反应主要受C2S的生长和Ca2+的扩散速率控制。硫硅酸钙具有潜在的水化活性，但P和F掺杂抑制了早期活性。值得注意的是，P掺杂样品在中后期较高的化学结合水含量反映了显著的水化潜力，其浆体在180 d时的抗压强度为16.6 MPa。对硫硅酸钙矿物反应机理和动力学的研究可为低碳水泥的生产和应用提供指导。

articles.title_en: Multi-scale modeling of cement-based materials under sulfate attack: Roles of phase assemblage and microstructural evolution in compressive strength
articles.title_cn: 硫酸盐侵蚀下水泥基材料的多尺度建模：相组成与微观结构演化对抗压强度的作用
articles.abstract_en: The degradation of cement-based materials under sulfate attack is primarily governed by the evolution of the microstructure and phase composition, while the contribution of each to the deterioration process remains unclear. Within the framework of continuum micromechanics, this study develops a hierarchical multi-scale model that upscales mechanical properties from the scale of hydration products to the concrete scale. The model sequentially defines representative volume elements at four scales, then upscales properties using multi-step and multi-level homogenization methods coupled with a quasi-brittle failure criterion, and validates the predictions against 400-day experimental data across cement paste, mortar, and concrete. The analysis elucidates how organizational forms at distinct material scales lead to variations in macroscopic performance, and provides a comprehensive explanation for the differing degrees of deterioration observed in cement paste, mortar and concrete. Based on quantitative results, this study identifies how microstructure and phase composition control strength evolution is systematically identified. Overall, this research provides a quantitative and physically grounded framework for predicting the long-term strength evolution of cement-based materials under sulfate attack, offering a reliable basis for durability assessment, service life prediction, and the design of corrosion-resistant concrete structures.
articles.abstract_cn: 硫酸盐侵蚀下水泥基材料的退化主要受微观结构和相组成演化的控制，而各自对退化过程的贡献仍不清楚。在连续介质细观力学的框架内，本研究开发了一个分层多尺度模型，将力学性能从水化产物尺度升级到混凝土尺度。该模型依次在四个尺度上定义代表性体积单元，然后使用多步和多级均匀化方法结合准脆性破坏准则升级性能，并针对水泥浆体、砂浆和混凝土的400天实验数据验证预测结果。分析阐明了不同材料尺度上的组织形式如何导致宏观性能的差异，并为水泥浆体、砂浆和混凝土观察到的不同程度退化提供了全面解释。基于定量结果，本研究系统性地识别了微观结构和相组成如何控制强度演化。总体而言，这项研究为预测硫酸盐侵蚀下水泥基材料的长期强度演化提供了一个定量且基于物理的框架，为耐久性评估、使用寿命预测和耐腐蚀混凝土结构设计提供了可靠依据。

articles.title_en: Rentier resource nationalism and overseas investment by multinational corporations: the impact of resource value
articles.title_cn: 食利型资源民族主义与跨国公司海外投资：资源价值的影响
articles.abstract_en: Characterized by its predatory nature and the institutional uncertainty, rentier resource nationalism (RRN) has emerged as a critical risk factor for overseas investment by multinational corporations (MNCs). However, existing literature rarely relies on theoretical models to analyze the differential impacts of RRN across heterogeneous investment objectives. Furthermore, the underlying role of resource value remains underexplored, particularly from the perspective of “cognitive divergence”. To address these gaps, this study develops a three-stage game model and investigates how RRN and resource value affect the economic variables of MNCs. The results reveal that RRN significantly reduces the residual profit and overseas investment outlay of MNCs, while increasing metal output. Through the lens of investment objective heterogeneity, MNCs targeting residual profit maximization suffer negative shocks. Conversely, MNCs aiming to ensure more resource supply can benefit from the dynamics, and exhibit a higher tolerance threshold for RRN intensity. The ultimate impact of resource value hinges on the relative strength of the market-size driving effect versus the resource-depletion inhibitory effect. Crucially, “cognitive divergence” regarding resource value serves as an important mechanism explaining the simultaneous emergence of intensified RRN and the expansion of investment outlay. This study provides a theoretical foundation for the rational formulation of RRN policies and enriches the theoretical framework of international investment.
articles.abstract_cn: 以掠夺性和制度不确定性为特征的食利型资源民族主义（RRN）已成为跨国公司（MNCs）海外投资的关键风险因素。然而，现有文献很少依赖理论模型来分析RRN对不同投资目标的差异化影响。此外，资源价值的潜在作用仍未得到充分探讨，特别是从“认知分歧”的角度。为弥补这些空白，本研究构建了一个三阶段博弈模型，并考察了RRN和资源价值如何影响跨国公司的经济变量。结果表明，RRN显著降低了跨国公司的剩余利润和海外投资支出，同时增加了金属产出。从投资目标异质性的视角来看，以剩余利润最大化为目标的跨国公司遭受负面冲击。相反，旨在确保更多资源供应的跨国公司可以从这种动态中受益，并对RRN强度表现出更高的容忍阈值。资源价值的最终影响取决于市场规模驱动效应与资源枯竭抑制效应的相对强度。至关重要的是，关于资源价值的“认知分歧”是解释RRN加剧和投资支出扩张同时出现的重要机制。本研究为合理制定RRN政策提供了理论基础，并丰富了国际投资的理论框架。

articles.title_en: Geochemical data imputation and anomaly detection based on diffusion models
articles.title_cn: 基于扩散模型的地球化学数据填补与异常检测
articles.abstract_en: Geochemical data commonly contain missing values and anomaly values. In studies represented by tectonic discrimination, the utilization rate of geochemical data typically ranges from 10% to 20% or even lower, which greatly restricts geochemical research and disciplinary development. To address these issues, this paper expands tectonic settings to seven categories covering both continental and oceanic environments. Based on generative models, this study proposes a missing value imputation model with multi-type feature processing and a self-supervised diffusion time estimation model for anomaly detection. In addition, this paper explores optimal data preprocessing strategies for different models, offering valuable recommendations for subsequent research and practical applications. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed models exhibit good feasibility and stability in geochemical missing value imputation and anomaly detection tasks. The mean squared error (MSE) for missing value imputation remains below 0.005, while the area under the curve for precision-recall (PR-AUC) for anomaly detection reaches 0.68, showing competitive performance over existing algorithms. Further tectonic discrimination experiments show that missing value imputation and anomaly detection have varying effects on different classification models. Specifically, missing value imputation is more effective in improving the classification performance of tree-based models, whereas anomaly detection has a more pronounced effect on models that are sensitive to anomalous samples, such as SVM.
articles.abstract_cn: 地球化学数据通常包含缺失值和异常值。在以构造判别为代表的研究中，地球化学数据的利用率通常在10%至20%甚至更低，这极大地限制了地球化学研究和学科发展。为解决这些问题，本文将构造环境扩展为涵盖大陆和海洋环境的七个类别。基于生成模型，本研究提出了一种具有多类型特征处理的缺失值填补模型和一种用于异常检测的自监督扩散时间估计模型。此外，本文探讨了不同模型的最优数据预处理策略，为后续研究和实际应用提供了有价值的建议。实验结果表明，所提出的模型在地球化学缺失值填补和异常检测任务中表现出良好的可行性和稳定性。缺失值填补的均方误差（MSE）保持在0.005以下，而异常检测的精确率-召回率曲线下面积（PR-AUC）达到0.68，显示出与现有算法相比具有竞争力的性能。进一步的构造判别实验表明，缺失值填补和异常检测对不同分类模型的影响各异。具体而言，缺失值填补在提高基于树的模型的分类性能方面更为有效，而异常检测对诸如SVM等对异常样本敏感的模型具有更显著的效果。

articles.title_en: Kinetic origins of Löwenstein's rule compliance during early-stage aluminosilicate nucleation: A reactive molecular dynamics study
articles.title_cn: 铝硅酸盐成核早期阶段洛文斯坦规则遵守的动力学起源：反应分子动力学研究
articles.abstract_en: Calcium aluminate silicate hydrate (C-A-S-H) nucleation critically influences the microstructural development of blended cementitious systems, yet the atomistic mechanisms by which Al modifies the earliest condensation stages remain poorly understood. Reactive force field molecular dynamics simulations are employed to investigate aluminosilicate cluster formation across Al/Si ratios of 0–0.30 and temperatures of 300–1000 K under high-supersaturation conditions representative of the spinodal regime. The computed activation energy for the pure silicate system (44 kJ/mol) is consistent with experimentally reported C-S-H condensation barriers (40–60 kJ/mol), validating the simulation framework. Al incorporation reduces this barrier to 15–37 kJ/mol, kinetically facilitating silicate condensation and promoting the formation of higher-connectivity aluminosilicate networks. A compositional crossover near Al/Si ≈ 0.15 marks the transition from Si-O-Al-dominated bridging to increasingly prevalent Al-O-Al linkage formation, comparison with a random-mixing baseline reveals that Al-O-Al bonds form at 5–6 times the statistically expected frequency, confirming kinetic trapping rather than random encounter as the origin of Löwenstein violations. Trajectory analysis further reveals that metastable Al-O-Al bonds reorganize into Löwenstein-compliant Si-O-Al linkages through ring-mediated rearrangement, providing an atomistic pathway for the emergence of Al avoidance in mature C-A-S-H structures. These findings provide a molecular-level kinetic complement for rationalizing Al/Si thresholds in the design of supplementary cementitious materials.
articles.abstract_cn: 水化铝硅酸钙（C-A-S-H）成核过程对混合胶凝体系的微观结构发展具有关键影响，然而铝在最早缩合阶段的作用机制在原子层面仍知之甚少。采用反应力场分子动力学模拟，研究了在代表旋节线区的高过饱和条件下，Al/Si比为0-0.30、温度为300-1000 K时铝硅酸盐团簇的形成过程。纯硅酸盐体系的计算活化能（44 kJ/mol）与实验报道的C-S-H缩合能垒（40-60 kJ/mol）一致，验证了模拟框架的可靠性。铝的掺入将该能垒降低至15-37 kJ/mol，在动力学上促进了硅酸盐缩合，并有利于形成更高连通性的铝硅酸盐网络。在Al/Si≈0.15附近出现成分交叉点，标志着由Si-O-Al主导的桥接向日益普遍的Al-O-Al键合转变；与随机混合基线相比，Al-O-Al键的形成频率是统计预期值的5-6倍，证实了动力学捕获而非随机碰撞是洛文斯坦违规的根源。轨迹分析进一步揭示，亚稳态的Al-O-Al键通过环介导的重排重组为符合洛文斯坦规则的Si-O-Al键，为成熟C-A-S-H结构中铝回避现象的出现提供了原子层面的路径。这些发现为补充胶凝材料设计中Al/Si阈值的合理化提供了分子层面的动力学补充。

articles.title_en: Surgical correction of unilateral soft palate and faucial pillar dysplasia: A systematic review & case report
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundUnilateral soft palate and faucial pillar dysplasia is a rare anomaly distinct from typical cleft palate. ObjectiveAmong patients with these anatomic findings, this study aims to define the consistent diagnostic features, assess surgical techniques for repair and speech outcomes. MethodsA systematic review of PubMed and Embase was conducted using the PRISMA protocol. A descriptive synthesis on patient demographics, surgical interventions, and outcomes was performed. A select patient case treated at the authors’ institution is presented. ResultsFifteen studies comprising 32 patients were included. All patients had unilateral soft palate deficiency with either dysplastic or absent faucial pillars. Twenty-six patients underwent surgical correction at a mean age of 33 months. The most common technique included soft palate dissection plus the addition of an adjacent interpolated flap. Twenty patients experienced improved speech; however, outcome only 53% of patients had follow-up >12 months. Four of 26 (15%) required revision surgery. ConclusionUnilateral soft palate and faucial pillar dysplasia demands surgical techniques distinct from traditional cleft palate repair methods. Due to the hypoplasia of the unilateral velum and faucial pillars, the use of adjacent flaps may represent an important feature of successful surgical treatment.

articles.title_en: VP-MonoMF: Visual prompt guided monocular 3D object detection with multiscale fusion
articles.title_cn: VP-MonoMF：基于视觉提示引导的多尺度融合单目3D目标检测
articles.abstract_en: Depth estimation from a single image remains a challenging task in monocular 3D object detection. Existing methods improve the detection accuracy by leveraging more precise 2D and 3D information. However, they simultaneously train 2D and 3D detection branches, which inevitably affect each other. Meanwhile, they often overlook the adverse effects caused by variations in camera pose. Furthermore, although they achieve satisfactory detection accuracy on large objects, their accuracy on small objects remains limited due to limited pixel areas. To address these issues, we propose a Visual Prompt Guided Monocular 3D Object Detection Method with Multiscale Fusion (VP-MonoMF). Specifically, we first develop a Multi-Depth Fusion (MDF) module as the 3D detection branch, which integrates multi-scale information from both global depth maps and local 3D depth information. Then, we train MDF in the first stage and the 2D Detector in the second stage to mitigate mutual interference. To minimize the impact of the camera pose variance, MDF utilizes a 3D Depth Reconstruction (3DR) module to correct depth map deviations. Furthermore, we introduce a Visual Prompt Fusion (VPF) module to enhance small object features by adaptively adjusting weights based on object size. We conduct experiments on the KITTI dataset. VP-MonoMF achieves state-of-the-art performance in monocular 3D object detection task. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/HFUT-CV/VP-MonoMF.
articles.abstract_cn: 从单张图像进行深度估计在单目3D目标检测中仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。现有方法通过利用更精确的2D和3D信息来提高检测精度。然而，它们同时训练2D和3D检测分支，这不可避免地会相互影响。同时，它们常常忽视相机姿态变化带来的不利影响。此外，尽管它们在大目标上取得了令人满意的检测精度，但由于像素区域有限，在小目标上的精度仍然受限。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种基于视觉提示引导的多尺度融合单目3D目标检测方法（VP-MonoMF）。具体来说，我们首先开发了一个多深度融合（MDF）模块作为3D检测分支，该模块整合了全局深度图和局部3D深度信息的多尺度信息。然后，我们在第一阶段训练MDF，在第二阶段训练2D检测器，以减轻相互干扰。为了最小化相机姿态变化的影响，MDF利用3D深度重建（3DR）模块来校正深度图偏差。此外，我们引入了一个视觉提示融合（VPF）模块，通过根据目标大小自适应调整权重来增强小目标特征。我们在KITTI数据集上进行了实验。VP-MonoMF在单目3D目标检测任务中达到了最先进的性能。代码可在https://github.com/HFUT-CV/VP-MonoMF公开获取。

articles.title_en: RFDPNet: Real-time frequency-aware detail prior network for underwater image enhancement
articles.title_cn: RFDPNet：用于水下图像增强的实时频率感知细节先验网络
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Underwater images encounter wavelength-dependent absorption and scattering, leading to severe color distortion, contrast degradation, and the loss of fine structural details. Most enhancement methods still face limitations in meeting real-time requirements and effectively exploiting frequency-aware detail cues for structural restoration. To address these challenges, we propose a real-time frequency-aware detail prior network (RFDPNet) for underwater image enhancement. Built upon an encoder-decoder architecture, RFDPNet introduces a frequency-guided upsampling module at the multi-scale fusion stage, where Sobel-derived high-frequency structural cues are used to effectively guide skip connections for fine-detail recovery. A spectral-spatial attention module is employed to adaptively correct inter-channel imbalance and enhance salient spatial features. The network is optimized using a channel-weighted gradient loss that assigns a higher weight to gradient discrepancies in the red channel to compensate for severe attenuation underwater. Extensive experiments on the LSUI, UIEB, and EUVP benchmark datasets demonstrate that RFDPNet achieves competitive enhancement performance while maintaining 117.6 FPS at 256 × 256 and 98.4 FPS at 720p on a single GPU.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 水下图像遭遇波长相关的吸收和散射，导致严重的颜色失真、对比度下降以及精细结构细节的丢失。大多数增强方法在满足实时要求和有效利用频率感知细节线索进行结构恢复方面仍面临限制。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种用于水下图像增强的实时频率感知细节先验网络（RFDPNet）。基于编码器-解码器架构，RFDPNet在多尺度融合阶段引入了一个频率引导的上采样模块，其中使用Sobel派生的高频结构线索来有效引导跳跃连接以恢复精细细节。采用光谱-空间注意力模块来自适应校正通道间不平衡并增强显著空间特征。网络通过通道加权梯度损失进行优化，该损失为红色通道中的梯度差异分配更高的权重，以补偿水下严重的衰减。在LSUI、UIEB和EUVP基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，RFDPNet在单个GPU上实现了竞争性的增强性能，同时在256×256分辨率下保持117.6 FPS，在720p分辨率下保持98.4 FPS。

articles.title_en: Decoupled gradient-guided stratification for resource-efficient multi-modal data pruning
articles.title_cn: 解耦梯度引导分层用于资源高效的多模态数据剪枝
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Instruction finetuning of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) relies on massive datasets, hindering scalability and efficiency. Consequently, data pruning has emerged as a vital strategy to attain full-dataset performance using a minimal subset. However, existing methods often incur high computational overheads or suffer from performance collapse at high pruning rates. To address these challenges, we propose Decoupled Gradient-Guided Stratification (DGGS), a resource-efficient data pruning framework. Diverging from approaches that introduce additional computation via external proxy models, we natively repurpose the internal vision encoder to stratify data based on visual complexity, and employ the LLM module as a deterministic verifier to quantify the semantic density of each stratum. DGGS dynamically allocates the pruning budget to stratified regions where semantic importance outweighs visual complexity, filtering out visual noise. Empirically, DGGS operates with minimal additional memory overhead and achieves robust performance, retaining approximately 85% of full-dataset performance with 1% of the training data.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的指令微调依赖于海量数据集，阻碍了可扩展性和效率。因此，数据剪枝已成为一种关键策略，旨在使用最小子集实现全数据集性能。然而，现有方法往往产生高计算开销，或在高剪枝率下遭受性能崩溃。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了解耦梯度引导分层（DGGS），一种资源高效的数据剪枝框架。与通过外部代理模型引入额外计算的方法不同，我们原生地重新利用内部视觉编码器，基于视觉复杂度对数据进行分层，并采用LLM模块作为确定性验证器，量化每个分层的语义密度。DGGS动态分配剪枝预算给语义重要性超过视觉复杂度的分层区域，过滤视觉噪声。实验上，DGGS以最小的额外内存开销运行，并实现稳健性能，在仅使用1%训练数据的情况下保留了全数据集性能的约85%。

articles.title_en: Scarred by nature: How early exposure to natural disasters shapes risk attitudes
articles.title_cn: 自然的烙印：早期自然灾害暴露如何塑造风险态度
articles.abstract_en: Can early-life experiences shape long-term risk attitudes? This paper examines the relationship between exposure to natural disasters during early adulthood and individual risk preferences later in life. Using harmonized survey data linked to disaster records, we find that individuals exposed to natural disasters between the ages of 18 and 25 exhibit significantly greater risk aversion later in life. This relationship proves robust across a range of alternative specifications. We further explore the role of cultural transmission as a mechanism, showing that social connectedness moderates the observed behavioral shift. Our findings underscore the impressionable years as a critical window for the formation of individual preferences. The study offers new insights into how climate-related shocks are linked to long-lasting behavioral patterns, with implications for public policy, economic behavior, and climate adaptation.
articles.abstract_cn: 早期生活经历能否塑造长期风险态度？本文考察了成年早期遭受自然灾害与个体晚年风险偏好之间的关系。利用与灾害记录相连接的协调调查数据，我们发现，在18岁至25岁之间经历自然灾害的个体，在晚年表现出显著更高的风险厌恶程度。这一关系在多种替代规格下均保持稳健。我们进一步探讨了文化传递作为机制的作用，表明社会联系调节了观察到的行为转变。我们的发现强调了可塑性年龄阶段作为个体偏好形成的关键窗口。本研究为气候相关冲击如何与持久行为模式相关联提供了新见解，对公共政策、经济行为和气候适应具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: Oceanic Alkalinity and titration Alkalinity: a novel straightforward approach in keeping with common general chemistry
articles.title_cn: 海洋碱度与滴定碱度：一种符合普通化学常规的新颖直接方法
articles.abstract_en: We present exact concepts of Oceanic Alkalinity and Titration Alkalinity that are in keeping with common chemistry. Oceanic Alkalinity is the difference between the sum of charges of strong cations and the sum of charges of strong anions in seawater. This difference is compensated by the sum of charges of the weak anions minus the sum of charges of the weak cations. The Titration Alkalinity of a natural seawater sample is defined as the concentration of all bases able to accept a hydrogen ion at the equivalence point of the carbonic acid system. Ideally, acid titration of all weak ions would yield a value of total consumption of added hydrogen ions that then would equate perfectly with the net sum of the charges of the strong ions in Oceanic Alkalinity. However, some adjustments are necessary. At the equivalence endpoint of the titration, hydrogen ions have also been absorbed by small portions of the strong SO42− and F− anions. Additionally, at the endpoint several phosphate anions are not completely neutralized to H3PO4. Due to this non-ideal situation, there is an exact difference between Oceanic Alkalinity and Titration Alkalinity:AlkOceanic = AlkTitration + 1.021 [DIP] - 0.0003966 [SO42−] - 0.010457 [F−]or in terms of salinityAlkOceanic = AlkTitration + 1.021 [DIP] - 0.3409 Swhere DIP is total dissolved inorganic phosphorus. This exact difference in the order of 12 to 15 μmol kg−1 is highly significant versus the best feasible ∼1 μmol kg−1 precision of the titration. Finally, because the concentration of Dissolved Inorganic Carbon is determined independently by coulometry, there is no need for non-linear curve fitting of the complete acid titration curve. It suffices to only fit the second part of the titration curve to determine the second equivalence point, yielding a more straightforward, and in principle more precise, determination of Titration Alkalinity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了与普通化学一致的海洋碱度和滴定碱度的精确概念。海洋碱度是海水中强阳离子电荷总和与强阴离子电荷总和之间的差值。该差值由弱阴离子电荷总和减去弱阳离子电荷总和来补偿。天然海水样品的滴定碱度定义为在碳酸系统等当点能够接受氢离子的所有碱的浓度。理想情况下，对所有弱离子的酸滴定将得到添加氢离子总消耗量的值，该值将与海洋碱度中强离子电荷的净总和完全相等。然而，需要进行一些调整。在滴定的等当终点，氢离子也被少量强SO42−和F−阴离子吸收。此外，在终点时，几种磷酸根阴离子并未完全中和为H3PO4。由于这种非理想情况，海洋碱度与滴定碱度之间存在精确差异：Alk海洋 = Alk滴定 + 1.021 [DIP] - 0.0003966 [SO42−] - 0.010457 [F−]或以盐度表示Alk海洋 = Alk滴定 + 1.021 [DIP] - 0.3409 S其中DIP为总溶解无机磷。这一精确差异在12至15 μmol kg−1量级，相对于滴定最佳可行的约1 μmol kg−1精度而言非常显著。最后，由于溶解无机碳浓度通过库仑法独立测定，无需对完整酸滴定曲线进行非线性曲线拟合。只需拟合滴定曲线的第二部分以确定第二等当点，从而更直接且原则上更精确地测定滴定碱度。

articles.title_en: Sleep disturbances in children with allergic rhinitis: Associations with rhinitis control and treatment response
articles.title_cn: 过敏性鼻炎儿童的睡眠障碍：与鼻炎控制和治疗反应的关系
articles.abstract_en: IntroductionAllergic rhinitis (AR), a common pediatric condition, is an established contributor to impaired sleep and sleep-disordered breathing. However, data on the relative impact of disease severity versus control on sleep remain limited. We aimed to investigate the associations between AR severity, disease control, and treatment response and sleep quality in Turkish children. MethodsIn this prospective study, 65 children aged 4-15 years with AR and 67 age-matched healthy controls were evaluated. Sleep quality, AR control, and AR severity were assessed using the Children's Sleep Habits Questionnaire (CSHQ), the Rhinoconjunctivitis Control Assessment Test (RCAT), and its Impact on Asthma (ARIA) guidelines, respectively. CSHQ scores were compared according to AR severity and control status and evaluated before and after three months of treatment. ResultsMean CSHQ scores were higher in the AR group than in controls (53.7 ± 8.7 vs. 47.5 ± 8.0, p < 0.001). AR was associated with disturbances in several CSHQ subdomains, including difficulty waking, fragmented sleep, sleep-disordered breathing, and parasomnias. CSHQ scores did not differ across AR severity categories (p = 0.216) but showed an inverse correlation with RCAT scores (r = −0.40, p = 0.001). Among 46 treated patients, sleep quality improved after therapy, particularly in the sleep fragmentation and sleep anxiety domains, with no significant difference between montelukast monotherapy and combined montelukast plus antihistamine therapy. ConclusionIn children with AR, sleep impairment is more closely related to rhinitis control than to symptom-based severity. Optimizing disease control, rather than focusing solely on severity, appears crucial for improving sleep and related functional outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 简介过敏性鼻炎 (AR) 是一种常见的儿科疾病，是导致睡眠障碍和睡眠呼吸障碍的一个确定因素。然而，关于疾病严重程度与控制对睡眠的相对影响的数据仍然有限。我们的目的是调查土耳其儿童 AR 严重程度、疾病控制、治疗反应和睡眠质量之间的关联。方法在这项前瞻性研究中，对65岁4-15岁患有AR的儿童和67年龄匹配的健康对照进行了评估。分别使用儿童睡眠习惯问卷 (CSHQ)、鼻结膜炎控制评估测试 (RCAT) 及其对哮喘的影响 (ARIA) 指南来评估睡眠质量、AR 控制和 AR 严重程度。根据 AR 严重程度和控制状态比较 CSHQ 评分，并在治疗三个月前和治疗后进行评估。结果 AR 组的平均 CSHQ 评分高于对照组（53.7 ± 8.7 与 47.5 ± 8.0，p < 0.001）。 AR 与多个 CSHQ 子域的紊乱有关，包括醒来困难、睡眠碎片、睡眠呼吸障碍和异态睡眠。 CSHQ 评分在 AR 严重程度类别之间没有差异 (p = 0.216)，但与 RCAT 评分呈负相关 (r = −0.40，p = 0.001)。在46接受治疗的患者中，治疗后睡眠质量得到改善，特别是在睡眠碎片化和睡眠焦虑方面，孟鲁司特单药治疗和孟鲁司特加抗组胺药联合治疗之间没有显着差异。结论在 AR 儿童中，睡眠障碍与鼻炎控制的关系比与症状严重程度的关系更密切。优化疾病控制，而不是仅仅关注严重程度，对于改善睡眠和相关功能结果似乎至关重要。

articles.title_en: Parental awareness of childhood hearing loss, risk factors and communication milestones following newborn hearing screening
articles.title_cn: 新生儿听力筛查后父母对儿童听力损失、风险因素及沟通里程碑的认知
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundThe prevalence of childhood hearing loss doubles from newborn period to school age. Parental concern and developmental checklists are often used to flag potential hearing loss after newborn screening, but parental concern alone is a poor indicator. This study explored parental awareness of childhood hearing loss, communication milestones, and risk factors, and particularly whether this knowledge was gained during the newborn period. MethodsA digital survey was anonymously completed by parents of children under 2 years old living in Sweden. ResultsWhile 98% of parents were aware of the impact of hearing loss on language development, only 56% recalled receiving information about early detection during newborn screening. Most parents (70%) believed a child could still have hearing loss despite passing the screening. This belief was less common among parents with lower education or who did not speak Swedish at home. Parents often underestimated the age at which children reach communication milestones, and 74% reported not considering hearing loss when their child failed to respond to a direction. ConclusionsParents demonstrated high overall awareness of childhood hearing loss. However, whether information was provided during newborn screening was inconsistent. The limited sensitivity of parental concern in detecting hearing loss may not stem from a lack of knowledge, but rather from the fact that parents often do not consider hearing loss as a possible explanation when their child does not respond in everyday situations.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景儿童听力损失的患病率从新生儿期到学龄期翻倍。父母担忧和发育检查表常用于在新生儿筛查后标记潜在的听力损失，但仅凭父母担忧是一个较差的指标。本研究探讨了父母对儿童听力损失、沟通里程碑和风险因素的认知，特别是这些知识是否在新生儿期获得。方法一项数字调查由居住在瑞典的2岁以下儿童的父母匿名完成。结果虽然98%的父母意识到听力损失对语言发展的影响，但只有56%的父母记得在新生儿筛查期间收到过关于早期检测的信息。大多数父母（70%）认为即使通过了筛查，孩子仍可能有听力损失。这一信念在受教育程度较低或在家不说瑞典语的父母中较少见。父母常常低估儿童达到沟通里程碑的年龄，74%的父母报告当孩子未能回应指令时未考虑听力损失。结论父母总体上对儿童听力损失表现出较高的认知。然而，在新生儿筛查期间是否提供信息并不一致。父母担忧在检测听力损失方面的有限敏感性可能并非源于缺乏知识，而是因为父母在日常生活中孩子不回应时往往不考虑听力损失作为可能的解释。

articles.title_en: LSBR-pkd: A lightweight model for student behavior recognition via co-optimization of pruning and knowledge distillation
articles.title_cn: LSBR-pkd：一种通过剪枝与知识蒸馏协同优化的轻量级学生行为识别模型
articles.abstract_en: The application of artificial intelligence in smart education has shown remarkable potential, highlighting the need to optimize neural network models for efficient deployment on edge devices. In this paper, we propose a lightweight dual-backbone model for student behavior recognition, which is based on the collaborative optimization of pruning and knowledge distillation (LSBR-pkd). We optimize the model architecture using lightweight modules, including an enhanced downsampling operation, an Efficient Group Convolution Head (EGCHead), and an improved feature extraction module, thereby achieving a favorable balance between model efficiency and accuracy. Building on this lightweight foundation, we combine structured pruning with knowledge distillation, leveraging their complementary advantages to compress the model while improving its recognition accuracy. Experimental results on the SCB-Dataset3-S demonstrate that LSBR-pkd reduces the parameter count and computational complexity to 27.7% and 55.4% of the baseline, respectively, while F1-score and mAP improved by 0.8-1.0%. The model exhibits superior comprehensive performance, fully meeting the deployment requirements of resource-constrained edge devices in smart classrooms.
articles.abstract_cn: 人工智能在智慧教育中的应用展现出显著潜力，凸显了优化神经网络模型以在边缘设备上高效部署的需求。本文提出了一种基于剪枝与知识蒸馏协同优化的轻量级双骨干学生行为识别模型（LSBR-pkd）。我们使用轻量级模块优化模型架构，包括增强的下采样操作、高效组卷积头（EGCHead）和改进的特征提取模块，从而在模型效率和准确性之间实现了良好的平衡。在此轻量级基础上，我们将结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏相结合，利用它们的互补优势来压缩模型，同时提高其识别准确性。在SCB-Dataset3-S上的实验结果表明，LSBR-pkd将参数数量和计算复杂度分别降低到基线的27.7%和55.4%，同时F1分数和mAP提高了0.8-1.0%。该模型展现出优越的综合性能，完全满足智慧教室中资源受限边缘设备的部署要求。

articles.title_en: Cash transfers and time use within the household: an analysis of the effect of <ce:italic>Familias en Acción</ce:italic>
articles.title_cn: 家庭内部的现金转移与时间使用：对“家庭行动”计划效应的分析
articles.abstract_en: Conditional cash transfers (CCTs) have been found to have several benefits, particularly with respect to educational outcomes of targeted children. However, concerns have also been raised that CCTs may further push women into traditional gender norms, as they make mothers responsible for ensuring that their children meet the conditionalities and that their family receives the transfer. We analyze 2020–21 time use data from Colombia, and find that the CCT Familias en Acción increased the time that mothers allocated to domestic work, particularly when they have children aged 6–14. This pattern does not come from a substitution between children’s and mothers’ domestic labor, but, rather, reveals that the cash transfer enabled women to decrease their labor force participation during the pandemic – but that their time was then reallocated toward more domestic work, following traditional norms.
articles.abstract_cn: 有条件现金转移（CCTs）已被发现具有多项益处，尤其是在目标儿童的教育成果方面。然而，也有人担忧CCTs可能进一步将女性推向传统性别规范，因为该计划使母亲负责确保其子女满足条件要求以及家庭获得转移支付。我们分析了哥伦比亚2020-21年的时间使用数据，发现CCT“家庭行动”计划增加了母亲用于家务劳动的时间，特别是当她们有6-14岁子女时。这一模式并非源于儿童与母亲家务劳动之间的替代，而是揭示了现金转移使女性在疫情期间能够减少劳动力参与——但她们的时间随后被重新分配至更多家务劳动，遵循了传统规范。

articles.title_en: Mapping mineralization-related geochemical patterns using self-organizing maps and SHAP interpretation in the Nanling belt, China
articles.title_cn: 利用自组织映射和SHAP解释绘制中国南岭成矿带矿化相关地球化学模式
articles.abstract_en: Mineralization anomaly identification is a crucial aspect of mineral exploration. Stream sediment geochemical data from the Nanling belt are characterized by high dimensionality, nonlinearity, and spatial heterogeneity, posing challenges for traditional anomaly detection methods (e.g., principal component analysis) that rely on linear assumptions or subjective parameter selection. This study presents an integrated SOM framework that combines k-means clustering analysis and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) method for mineralization-related geochemical anomaly identification and feature interpretability analysis. The SOM model effectively processed high-dimensional geochemical data by combining cluster analysis and component plane analysis, and two distinctive element combinations were identified. The first consists of U–Y–La–Th–Be–Na–Nb–Zr–Ba–Al2O3 that reflects granite-related ore-forming system, especially for radioactive metal (e.g., U and Th) and rare earth elements (REE, e.g., Y and La) mineralization. The second is composed of W–Sn–Bi–Ag–Mo–As–Cd–Cu–F–Pb–Zn that mainly reflects tungsten polymetallic mineralization. Based on the supervised classifier trained on binary labels derived from the SOM clustering results, the SHAP method quantified the contribution of each element within the two element combinations, providing an interpretable framework that highlights the significant contributions of Th and U to the granite mineralization system in the first element combination, and W, Bi, and Sn as central to tungsten polymetallic mineralization in the second element combination. The model performance was evaluated with known ore deposits as the ground truth labels by using the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve analysis, showing that the AUC values for SOM models related to REE mineralization and tungsten polymetallic mineralization were 0.839 and 0.842, respectively. Compared to existing models applied in the Nanling region, such as uniform manifold approximation and projection model, the constructed SOM model demonstrates superior adaptability to high-dimensional nonlinear geochemical data and better preservation of spatial topological relationships. This integrated framework offers a transferable and interpretable approach for geochemical anomaly identification, providing a methodological reference for mineral prospectivity mapping in comparable metallogenic regions.
articles.abstract_cn: 矿化异常识别是矿产勘探的关键方面。南岭地区的河流沉积物地球化学数据具有高维性、非线性和空间异质性，给依赖线性假设或主观参数选择的传统异常检测方法（如主成分分析）带来了挑战。本研究提出了一个集成的SOM框架，结合k均值聚类分析和SHapley加性解释（SHAP）方法，用于矿化相关地球化学异常识别和特征可解释性分析。SOM模型通过结合聚类分析和分量平面分析有效处理了高维地球化学数据，并识别出两个独特的元素组合。第一个组合由U–Y–La–Th–Be–Na–Nb–Zr–Ba–Al2O3组成，反映了与花岗岩相关的成矿系统，特别是放射性金属（如U和Th）和稀土元素（REE，如Y和La）的矿化。第二个组合由W–Sn–Bi–Ag–Mo–As–Cd–Cu–F–Pb–Zn组成，主要反映钨多金属矿化。基于由SOM聚类结果衍生的二元标签训练的有监督分类器，SHAP方法量化了每个元素在两个元素组合中的贡献，提供了一个可解释的框架，突出显示了Th和U在第一个元素组合中对花岗岩成矿系统的重要贡献，以及W、Bi和Sn在第二个元素组合中对钨多金属矿化的核心作用。模型性能以已知矿床作为真实标签，通过接收者操作特征（ROC）曲线分析进行评估，结果显示与REE矿化和钨多金属矿化相关的SOM模型的AUC值分别为0.839和0.842。与南岭地区应用的现有模型（如均匀流形逼近和投影模型）相比，所构建的SOM模型表现出对高维非线性地球化学数据更优的适应性，并更好地保留了空间拓扑关系。该集成框架为地球化学异常识别提供了一种可迁移且可解释的方法，为类似成矿区的矿产远景填图提供了方法论参考。

articles.title_en: Transport and transformation of dissolved inorganic carbon from cave systems to a surface watershed: a case study from Jiguan Cave and the Yi River headwater, central China
articles.abstract_en: The transport and transformation of dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) from cave systems to surface waters remain insufficiently constrained in karst watersheds. This study combines 13 years of monitoring data from Jiguan Cave (2010–2022) with watershed sampling from the Yi River headwater in 2022 to examine DIC and δ13CDIC variations along a pathway from the cave system to the river and reservoir. The results show that: (1) From 2010 to 2022, local normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) increased from 0.36 to 0.42, while DIC in LYXS drip water increased from 5.85 to 7.4 mmol/L and δ13CDIC shifted from −13.40‰ to −14.52‰. These changes are consistent with a possible increase in the influence of soil-derived carbon along the LYXS pathway. In contrast, pool waters and the underground river did not show comparable long-term DIC increases, reflecting spatially heterogeneous DIC behavior within the cave system. This heterogeneity may be related to differences in water storage, residence time, mixing, fracture-flow pathways, and hydrological connectivity. Extreme climate events were also associated with DIC variability, with DIC peaking in years with high precipitation (2010, 2011, 2017, 2021) and a delayed decline after the 2013 drought. (2) SIc results show that drip and pool waters were commonly supersaturated with respect to calcite, consistent with a thermodynamic tendency for CO2 degassing and/or calcite precipitation. In contrast, the underground river was generally closer to undersaturation, consistent with its potential role as a pathway for exporting DIC associated with soil CO2 input and carbonate dissolution. (3) The Jiguan Cave underground river provides a hydrological and geochemical input to the Shilonggou River (SLGR), which subsequently joins the YR. Along the flow path (underground river, SLGR, and YR), downstream δ13CDIC enrichment was observed and is consistent with the combined effects of mixing, CO2 degassing, and potential aquatic biological uptake. Specifically, in the rainy season, δ13CDIC progressively increased from the underground outlet (−20.99‰) to the SLGR (−19.48‰) and the YR (−15.88‰). At the SLGR-YR confluence in July, a DIC-constrained two-endmember calculation predicted a conservative-mixing δ13CDIC value of −21.75‰ at YR2, whereas the measured value was −13.87‰. The 7.88‰ enrichment indicates that conservative mixing alone cannot explain the measured downstream δ13CDIC value. In contrast, higher DIC and more enriched δ13CDIC during the dry season likely reflect longer water-rock interaction and stronger groundwater contribution. (4) In Jinniuling Reservoir, stratification sampling in July showed enriched δ13CDIC in surface water (−13.93‰) relative to deep water (−19.76‰), with slightly lower surface DIC. This vertical pattern is consistent with biological and/or physical modification of the reservoir DIC pool. Whether these processes contribute to long-term carbon retention requires direct measurements of aquatic productivity and sedimentary carbon burial. The hydrochemically estimated inorganic carbon export ranged from approximately 1.27 × 104 to 1.41 × 104 t CO2/yr. This estimated inorganic carbon export represents hydrochemical DIC transport rather than a net carbon sink. These results provide site-specific evidence that soil- and cave-derived DIC is transported to surface waters and subsequently modified by hydrological, geochemical, and biological processes.

articles.title_en: Diagnosing RAG vulnerabilities via sensitive knowledge recognition
articles.title_cn: 通过敏感知识识别诊断RAG漏洞
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance the factual accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge bases. However, certain knowledge within these bases may be incorrectly retrieved by RAG, thereby disrupting subsequent processes. Through analysis, we identify two patterns of sensitive knowledge, both refer to top-ranked yet irrelevant knowledge retrieved by the system that may induce LLMs to output hallucinations. Unlike poisoned knowledge from adversarial attacks, sensitive knowledge is legitimate. We propose Robustness and Availability Assessment via Internal Sensitive Knowledge Profiling (RAISP) framework to analyzes sensitive knowledge and its impact on RAG’s robustness and availability. Specifically, RAISP identifies sensitive knowledge and classifies it into two distinct patterns, establishing dedicated detection thresholds for each; it also simulates retrieval offset to investigate how RAG robustness affects retrieval outcomes and analyzes the influence of sensitive knowledge within the knowledge base on LLM outputs.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通过整合外部知识库来增强大型语言模型（LLMs）的事实准确性。然而，这些知识库中的某些知识可能被RAG错误检索，从而干扰后续过程。通过分析，我们识别出两种敏感知识模式，均指系统检索到的排名靠前但无关的知识，可能诱导LLMs产生幻觉。与对抗性攻击中的有毒知识不同，敏感知识是合法的。我们提出了基于内部敏感知识画像的鲁棒性与可用性评估（RAISP）框架，以分析敏感知识及其对RAG鲁棒性和可用性的影响。具体而言，RAISP识别敏感知识并将其分类为两种不同模式，为每种模式建立专门的检测阈值；同时，它模拟检索偏移以研究RAG鲁棒性如何影响检索结果，并分析知识库中敏感知识对LLM输出的影响。

articles.title_en: Experimental simulations and regional estimates of mercury emissions from fire-affected Cerrado soils (Central Brazil)
articles.title_cn: 受火灾影响的塞拉多土壤（巴西中部）汞排放的实验模拟与区域估算
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors Wildfires are increasingly recognized as drivers of mercury (Hg) mobilization in tropical ecosystems, yet their effects on soil biogeochemistry across Cerrado vegetation formations remain poorly constrained. This study evaluated total mercury (THg) stocks, soil composition, and fire-induced Hg losses in forest, savanna, and grassland soils from the Águas Emendadas Ecological Station (ESECAE), central Brazil. Laboratory heating experiments simulated low (200 °C), intermediate (350 °C), and high (500 °C) fire intensities, combined with elemental and mineralogical characterization and regional emission estimates based on burned area data. Forest soils exhibited significantly higher THg concentrations, organic carbon content, and C/N ratios than savanna and grassland soils, reflecting stronger Hg association with organic matter and reduced ultraviolet radiation exposure. Simulated burning resulted in substantial Hg mobilization, with losses exceeding 70% even at low intensity and reaching near-total depletion at moderate and high temperatures. Mercury emission factors were consistently highest in forest soils (3.85 ± 0.74 g Hg ha −1 ), compared to savanna (2.47 ± 0.46 g Hg ha −1 ) and grassland formations (1.2 ± 0.59 g Hg ha −1 ). Regional scaling indicated that fires mobilized up to 173 kg of Hg in the Federal District (Capital of Brazil) over the last decade. Alterations in organic matter quantity and quality closely paralleled Hg release, highlighting the central role of soil carbon in regulating Hg stability during combustion. While major-element concentrations remained stable, mineralogical transformations were pronounced, indicating secondary controls on Hg retention.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者 野火日益被认为是热带生态系统中汞（Hg）迁移的驱动因素，但其对塞拉多植被类型下土壤生物地球化学的影响仍知之甚少。本研究评估了巴西中部阿瓜斯埃门达达斯生态站（ESECAE）森林、稀树草原和草地土壤中的总汞（THg）储量、土壤组成及火灾引起的汞损失。实验室加热实验模拟了低（200 °C）、中（350 °C）和高（500 °C）火灾强度，并结合元素和矿物学表征以及基于过火面积数据的区域排放估算。森林土壤的THg浓度、有机碳含量和C/N比显著高于稀树草原和草地土壤，反映出汞与有机质的更强关联以及紫外线辐射暴露的减少。模拟燃烧导致大量汞迁移，即使在低强度下损失也超过70%，在中温和高温下几乎完全耗尽。汞排放因子在森林土壤中始终最高（3.85 ± 0.74 克汞/公顷−1），其次是稀树草原（2.47 ± 0.46 克汞/公顷−1）和草地（1.2 ± 0.59 克汞/公顷−1）。区域尺度估算表明，过去十年中，联邦区（巴西首都）的火灾迁移了多达173千克的汞。有机质数量和质量的改变与汞释放密切相关，凸显了土壤碳在燃烧过程中调节汞稳定性的核心作用。虽然主要元素浓度保持稳定，但矿物学转变显著，表明存在对汞保留的次要控制因素。

articles.title_en: SigConvNeXt: An improved lightweight ConvNeXt for offline signature verification
articles.title_cn: SigConvNeXt：一种改进的轻量级ConvNeXt用于离线签名验证
articles.abstract_en: Offline signature verification is a key biometric technology with broad applications in finance, law, and document authentication. Existing feature extraction methods, primarily convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs), often suffer from incomplete multi-scale feature capture, limited cross-dataset generalization, and high computational complexity. To address these challenges, this paper proposes SigConvNeXt, a lightweight offline signature verification model based on ConvNeXt V2-Tiny integrated into a Siamese network for end-to-end contrastive learning. We introduce two novel modules: an Attention Refinement Module (ARM) that enhances focus on discriminative signature regions via channel and spatial attention, suppressing background noise; and a Multiscale Bidirectional Fusion Module (MSBFM) that integrates multi-granularity features through bottom-up and top-down interactions, capturing both global structural semantics and local stroke details. Experiments on CEDAR, BHSig-B, and BHSig-H datasets demonstrate competitive performance, achieving EERs of 0.00%±0.00%, 8.74%±0.24%, and 8.48%±0.88%, respectively, with only 32M parameters, fewer than comparable baselines. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of ARM and MSBFM, while cross-dataset evaluation highlights strong generalization across languages.
articles.abstract_cn: 离线签名验证是一种关键的生物识别技术，在金融、法律和文档认证中具有广泛应用。现有的特征提取方法，主要是卷积神经网络（CNNs）和视觉变换器（ViTs），常常存在多尺度特征捕获不完整、跨数据集泛化能力有限以及计算复杂度高的问题。为解决这些挑战，本文提出了SigConvNeXt，一种基于ConvNeXt V2-Tiny的轻量级离线签名验证模型，集成到孪生网络中进行端到端对比学习。我们引入了两个新颖模块：注意力精炼模块（ARM），通过通道和空间注意力增强对判别性签名区域的关注，抑制背景噪声；以及多尺度双向融合模块（MSBFM），通过自下而上和自上而下的交互整合多粒度特征，捕获全局结构语义和局部笔画细节。在CEDAR、BHSig-B和BHSig-H数据集上的实验展示了竞争性能，分别实现了0.00%±0.00%、8.74%±0.24%和8.48%±0.88%的等错误率（EERs），仅使用32M参数，少于可比基线。消融研究证实了ARM和MSBFM的有效性，而跨数据集评估则突显了跨语言的强泛化能力。

articles.title_en: Deep CO<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf> and heat transport by basal springs across the Tyrrhenian–Apennine transition zone (central–southern Italy)
articles.title_cn: 第勒尼安-亚平宁过渡带（意大利中部-南部）的深层 CO<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf> 和底泉的热量传输
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors Natural CO 2 degassing through carbonate aquifers represents a major component of the geological carbon cycling in tectonically active regions, even if a robust database of global quantification is still lacking in literature. Although the central-southern Apennines are recognized as one of the main non-volcanic degassing zones in the Mediterranean area, the magnitude of deep CO 2 and heat transfer through high-discharge cold springs remains largely underestimated. The aim is to quantify the amount of deep-derived CO 2 and associated thermal fluxes transported by large karst aquifers between the Simbruini-Ernici-Cairo-Venafro carbonate basins and the Aurunci chain, through an integrated hydrogeochemical and isotopic approach. Major ion chemistry, stable isotopes δ 13 C of total dissolved inorganic carbon and δ 18 O, were combined with thermodynamic modelling, carbon mass balance, and energy balance calculations to constrain gas–water–rock interactions and isolate deep carbon contributions. Results showed that cold and hypothermal springs transport ∼505 tons/d of deep-derived C, with δ 13 C values (up to ∼0‰) highlighting a dominant mantle and/or deep-crustal origin. Energy balance reveals groundwater temperature increases of 1–2 °C and a cumulative thermal energy of ∼77.85 (MW). These findings demonstrate that carbonate aquifers act as efficient pathways for deep carbon and heat, contributing to regional carbon budgets at levels comparable to persistently degassing volcanic systems. The study highlights the role of groundwater-mediated CO 2 transport as a key, and often overlooked, process in continental geological carbon cycling.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者 尽管文献中仍然缺乏可靠的全球量化数据库，但通过碳酸盐含水层的自然二氧化碳2脱气代表了构造活跃地区地质碳循环的主要组成部分。尽管亚平宁山脉中南部被认为是地中海地区主要的非火山脱气区之一，但深层二氧化碳2和通过高流量冷泉传递的热量仍然被大大低估。目的是通过综合水文地球化学和同位素方法，量化 Simbruini-Ernici-Cairo-Venafro 碳酸盐盆地和 Aurunci 链之间大型岩溶含水层输送的深层 CO 2 量和相关热通量。主要离子化学、总溶解无机碳的稳定同位素 δ 13 C 和 δ 18 O 与热力学模型、碳质量平衡和能量平衡计算相结合，以约束气-水-岩石相互作用并隔离深层碳贡献。结果表明，冷泉和低温泉每天输送~505吨深部来源的碳，δ13碳值（高达~0‰）突出了主要的地幔和/或深部地壳起源。能量平衡显示地下水温度增加了 1-2 °C，累积热能 ~77.85 (MW)。这些发现表明，碳酸盐含水层是深层碳和热量的有效途径，对区域碳预算的贡献与持续脱气的火山系统相当。该研究强调了地下水介导的二氧化碳2运输作为大陆地质碳循环中一个关键但经常被忽视的过程的作用。

articles.title_en: Concrete printing with textile reinforcement: Approaches, classification, and testing
articles.title_cn: 纺织增强混凝土打印：方法、分类与测试
articles.abstract_en: The integration of reinforcement remains a key challenge in 3D concrete printing (3DCP) and continues to limit its structural application. Existing approaches are largely based on metallic reinforcement or discrete fibers and are not fully compatible with the geometric flexibility and process characteristics of additive manufacturing. Textile reinforcement, consisting of continuous fiber-based yarns arranged in two- or three-dimensional architectures, offers a promising alternative due to its flexibility, high tensile strength, and corrosion resistance.This paper presents a comprehensive review and proposes a process-based classification framework for the integration of textile reinforcement into 3DCP. Building on the RILEM taxonomy for digital fabrication with concrete, integration strategies are systematically categorized according to their position within the manufacturing sequence, distinguishing between single-step processes during concrete shaping and two-step processes before or after shaping. The framework is used to analyze existing approaches and to relate them to reinforcement configurations, bond mechanisms, and resulting mechanical performance. Particular attention is given to testing methodologies and the specific challenges associated with additively manufactured textile-reinforced concrete. The study highlights key limitations, particularly with respect to bond, anisotropy, and process constraints, and provides guidance for the development of structurally efficient and scalable 3D-printed systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 增强材料的整合仍然是3D混凝土打印（3DCP）中的关键挑战，并继续限制其结构应用。现有方法主要基于金属增强材料或离散纤维，与增材制造的几何灵活性和工艺特性不完全兼容。纺织增强材料由连续纤维基纱线以二维或三维结构排列而成，因其柔韧性、高抗拉强度和耐腐蚀性，提供了一种有前景的替代方案。本文进行了全面综述，并提出了一个基于过程的分类框架，用于将纺织增强材料整合到3DCP中。基于RILEM关于混凝土数字制造的分类法，整合策略根据其在制造序列中的位置进行系统分类，区分为混凝土成型过程中的单步过程和成型前或成型后的两步过程。该框架用于分析现有方法，并将其与增强配置、粘结机制和由此产生的力学性能相关联。特别关注测试方法以及与增材制造纺织增强混凝土相关的特定挑战。研究强调了关键局限性，特别是在粘结、各向异性和工艺约束方面，并为开发结构高效且可扩展的3D打印系统提供了指导。

articles.title_en: Risk of post-tonsillectomy hemorrhage in pediatric patients with recent influenza or COVID-19 infection
articles.title_cn: 近期感染流感或COVID-19的儿科患者扁桃体切除术后出血风险
articles.abstract_en: IntroductionPostoperative hemorrhage is a significant complication of tonsillectomy with or without adenoidectomy. This retrospective cohort study evaluates whether COVID-19 or influenza infection within defined preoperative intervals increases hemorrhage risk in patients under 18 years of age. MethodsUsing the TriNetX database, we identified pediatric patients who underwent tonsillectomy with or without adenoidectomy and had documented COVID-19 or influenza infection within six, three, or one month before surgery. Cohorts included patients with COVID-19 only, influenza only, and a control group with neither infection. Propensity score matching was performed. Risk ratios (RR) and 95% confidence intervals (CI) for postoperative hemorrhage were calculated for postoperative days 0–1, 2–5, and 6–10. ResultsInfluenza infection within six, three, or one month before surgery was not associated with an increased risk of postoperative hemorrhage at any time point. COVID-19 infection was associated with a significantly increased risk of secondary hemorrhage (postoperative days 2–5 and 6–10) across all preoperative intervals. No increase in primary hemorrhage (postoperative days 0–1) was observed with COVID-19 at any interval. ConclusionPediatric patients with a COVID-19 infection within six, three, or one month prior to tonsillectomy with or without adenoidectomy are at increased risk of secondary postoperative hemorrhage. Recent influenza infection does not confer increased risk of either primary or secondary hemorrhage. Clinicians should counsel families regarding the elevated risk associated with recent COVID-19 and consider additional perioperative precautions in affected patients.
articles.abstract_cn: 引言：术后出血是扁桃体切除术（伴或不伴腺样体切除术）的重要并发症。这项回顾性队列研究评估了在术前特定时间间隔内感染COVID-19或流感是否增加18岁以下患者的出血风险。方法：利用TriNetX数据库，我们确定了接受扁桃体切除术（伴或不伴腺样体切除术）且在术前六、三或一个月内有记录的COVID-19或流感感染的儿科患者。队列包括仅感染COVID-19的患者、仅感染流感的患者以及未感染这两种疾病的对照组。进行了倾向性评分匹配。计算了术后第0-1天、第2-5天和第6-10天术后出血的风险比（RR）和95%置信区间（CI）。结果：术前六、三或一个月内的流感感染在任何时间点均未与术后出血风险增加相关。COVID-19感染在所有术前时间间隔内均与继发性出血（术后第2-5天和第6-10天）风险显著增加相关。在任何时间间隔内，未观察到COVID-19感染与原发性出血（术后第0-1天）增加相关。结论：在扁桃体切除术（伴或不伴腺样体切除术）前六、三或一个月内感染COVID-19的儿科患者，其术后继发性出血风险增加。近期流感感染不增加原发性或继发性出血风险。临床医生应就近期COVID-19感染相关的升高风险向家属提供咨询，并考虑对受影响患者采取额外的围手术期预防措施。

articles.title_en: Effect of the temperature on the degradation of dissolved organic matter originated from different land use – an incubation experiment
articles.title_cn: 温度对不同土地利用来源溶解性有机质降解的影响——一项培养实验
articles.abstract_en: The DOM cycle in terrestrial ecosystems is of particular interest in light of climate change, as DOM is one of the largest sources of available organic carbon for microorganisms and also has numerous other ecological functions. Therefore, this study investigated the effects of temperature on the composition, transformation, and decomposition of soil dissolved organic matter (DOM) originated from different land use areas (grassland, spruce, oak, arable) in a temperate region of Hungary using a 45-day laboratory incubation experiment. The chemical composition of DOM was evaluated using PARAFAC modelling, and the changes occurring during incubation were evaluated using two-dimensional correlation spectroscopy (2D COS). Significant differences were found in the chemical composition of DOM fractions in soils with different land uses. The PARAFAC model showed that although the relative amount of the low molecular weight compounds was similar in all four soils, the DOM fraction of arable soil also contained a large amount of the C2 component (high molecular weight, aromatic compounds). In contrast, the C5 component, identified as aromatic proteins/soluble microbial product (AP/SMP), was the smallest in the DOM fraction of arable soil. According to the 2D COS analysis, biogeochemical coupling was detected as negative correlations in the synchronous spectra, with correlations between the ∼320-258, 320-278, 385-258, and 350-280 nm regions at both temperatures indicating biogeochemical coupling between low molecular weight and higher molecular weight compounds. The decomposition of spruce soil DOM differed significantly for incubation at 25 and 35 °C: at the higher temperature, DOM shifted towards organic compounds with lower molecular weights than those observed at the lower temperature.
articles.abstract_cn: 在气候变化背景下，陆地生态系统中的溶解性有机质（DOM）循环备受关注，因为DOM是微生物可利用有机碳的最大来源之一，并且还具有许多其他生态功能。因此，本研究利用为期45天的实验室培养实验，调查了温度对匈牙利温带地区不同土地利用区域（草地、云杉、橡树、耕地）土壤溶解性有机质（DOM）组成、转化和分解的影响。采用PARAFAC模型评估DOM的化学组成，并使用二维相关光谱（2D COS）评估培养过程中发生的变化。不同土地利用土壤中DOM组分的化学组成存在显著差异。PARAFAC模型显示，尽管四种土壤中低分子量化合物的相对含量相似，但耕地土壤的DOM组分还含有大量的C2组分（高分子量、芳香族化合物）。相比之下，被鉴定为芳香族蛋白质/可溶性微生物产物（AP/SMP）的C5组分在耕地土壤的DOM组分中含量最少。根据2D COS分析，同步光谱中检测到生物地球化学耦合表现为负相关，在∼320-258、320-278、385-258和350-280 nm区域的相关性在两种温度下均表明低分子量化合物与较高分子量化合物之间存在生物地球化学耦合。云杉土壤DOM的分解在25和35°C培养条件下存在显著差异：在较高温度下，DOM向比较低温度下观察到的分子量更低的有机化合物转变。

articles.title_en: Mercury pollution remediation in paddy fields with biochar amendment
articles.title_cn: 生物炭改良对稻田汞污染修复的研究
articles.abstract_en: Mercury (Hg) contamination in rice fields poses significant health risks to local populations. Conventional remediation methods are often costly, limiting widespread field application. Biochar amendment, noted for its cost-effectiveness and environmental compatibility, has been widely used to remediate heavy metal-contaminated paddy soils. However, its effectiveness and underlying mechanism in controlling Hg pollution remains unclear. In this study, field and laboratory experiments were carried out to evaluate the potential of biochar amendment in mitigating Hg accumulation in rice grains. The results indicated that total mercury (THg) concentrations in rice grains in the treatment group reduced to below the national limit (GB 2762-2022), methylmercury (MeHg) concentrations rice grain reduced 21% compared to the control group. Furthermore, the ratio of bioavailable THg to soil THg decreased by 51.4%, and the ratio of THg in rice grains to soil THg decreased by 32% in the treatment group compared to the control group. Additionally, biochar addition led to a 10.2% increase in rice grain yield. Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) analysis demonstrated biochar's ability to adsorb THg in paddy soil, while Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) analysis revealed that functional groups such as hydroxyl, carboxyl, amide, and S-containing groups on the biochar surface could form complexes with Hg. Laboratory adsorption simulations revealed that biochar reached adsorption equilibrium within 30 min, achieving its highest adsorption capacity (9.75 mg/g) at pH = 4. These findings demonstrated the efficacy of biochar amendments in remediating Hg contaminated paddy soils, offering a promising strategy for farmland safety use.
articles.abstract_cn: 稻田中的汞（Hg）污染对当地居民构成显著的健康风险。传统的修复方法往往成本高昂，限制了其在大规模田间应用中的推广。生物炭改良因其成本效益和环境兼容性而被广泛用于修复重金属污染的稻田土壤。然而，其在控制汞污染方面的有效性及潜在机制仍不清楚。本研究通过田间和实验室实验评估了生物炭改良在减少水稻籽粒中汞积累方面的潜力。结果表明，处理组水稻籽粒中的总汞（THg）浓度降至国家限量标准（GB 2762-2022）以下，甲基汞（MeHg）浓度相比对照组降低了21%。此外，与对照组相比，处理组中生物可利用THg与土壤THg的比例降低了51.4%，水稻籽粒中THg与土壤THg的比例降低了32%。另外，添加生物炭使水稻籽粒产量增加了10.2%。透射电子显微镜（TEM）分析表明，生物炭能够吸附稻田土壤中的THg，而傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）分析揭示，生物炭表面的羟基、羧基、酰胺基和含硫基团等功能团能与汞形成络合物。实验室吸附模拟显示，生物炭在30分钟内达到吸附平衡，在pH=4时达到最大吸附容量（9.75 mg/g）。这些发现证明了生物炭改良在修复汞污染稻田土壤中的有效性，为农田安全利用提供了一种有前景的策略。

articles.title_en: Source-oriented ecological and human health risk assessment of potentially toxic elements in surface soils of the Chengdu Basin using APCS-MLR and Monte Carlo simulation
articles.title_cn: 基于APCS-MLR和蒙特卡洛模拟的成都盆地表层土壤潜在有毒元素源导向生态与人体健康风险评估
articles.abstract_en: In alluvial-proluvial basin soils, inherited geochemical backgrounds and modern anthropogenic inputs commonly overlap, making it difficult to infer ecological and human health risks from concentration-based source apportionment alone. To address this issue, this study developed a dual-background, source-oriented probabilistic risk framework to identify source-specific ecological and human health risk priorities of potentially toxic elements (PTEs). Using 3061 surface soil samples and 832 deep soil samples from the Chengdu Basin, southwestern China, we evaluated As, Cd, Cr, Cu, Hg, Ni, Pb and Zn by integrating APCS-MLR source apportionment, an UNMIX-principle-based source-structure consistency assessment, Monte Carlo probabilistic risk assessment and source-oriented risk apportionment.Five source groups were identified: a natural geogenic source, an agricultural nutrient-related source, a mixed anthropogenic source, an atmospheric Hg source and a U–As geochemical background source. Source-oriented risk apportionment showed that ecological and human health risks were characterized by different risk-controlling elements and source categories. Although the agricultural nutrient-related source dominated the closed concentration contribution matrix, ecological risk was amplified mainly by the Hg and Cd fractions assigned to the agricultural nutrient-related and atmospheric Hg sources. Under the deep local background scenario, the median and 95th percentile of the potential ecological risk index (RI) were 139.05 and 307.12, respectively, and the probability of RI≥300 was 5.72%, indicating generally low to moderate ecological risk with a localized high-risk upper tail.Human health risk was controlled by different element-source combinations. Mean hazard index (HI) values for adults and children were 0.0851 and 0.2717, respectively, whereas the probabilities of total carcinogenic risk (TCR) > 1 × 10^-4 were 12.86% and 3.38%. Unlike ecological risk, health risk was driven mainly by Cr and Ni from the natural geogenic source, with secondary contributions from as in the U–As geochemical background source and Pb in the mixed anthropogenic source. These findings indicate that ecological and human health risk priorities differed in controlling elements, source categories and risk-weighting pathways, rather than being governed by distinct geochemical mechanisms alone. The dual-background and source-oriented probabilistic framework can therefore support differentiated ecological risk management and human health risk prevention in regions affected by both pedogenic inheritance and diffuse anthropogenic inputs.
articles.abstract_cn: 在冲洪积盆地土壤中，继承的地球化学背景与现代人为输入通常重叠，使得仅基于浓度的源解析难以推断生态和人体健康风险。为解决这一问题，本研究开发了一个双背景、源导向的概率风险框架，以识别潜在有毒元素（PTEs）的特定源生态和人体健康风险优先级。利用成都盆地（中国西南部）的3061个表层土壤样本和832个深层土壤样本，通过整合APCS-MLR源解析、基于UNMIX原理的源结构一致性评估、蒙特卡洛概率风险评估和源导向风险分配，评估了As、Cd、Cr、Cu、Hg、Ni、Pb和Zn。识别出五个源组：自然地质成因源、农业养分相关源、混合人为源、大气Hg源和U–As地球化学背景源。源导向风险分配表明，生态和人体健康风险具有不同的风险控制元素和源类别。尽管农业养分相关源主导了封闭的浓度贡献矩阵，但生态风险主要由分配给农业养分相关源和大气Hg源的Hg和Cd组分放大。在深层局部背景情景下，潜在生态风险指数（RI）的中位数和第95百分位数分别为139.05和307.12，RI≥300的概率为5.72%，表明总体生态风险为低至中等，并具有局部高风险的上尾分布。人体健康风险由不同的元素-源组合控制。成人和儿童的平均危害指数（HI）值分别为0.0851和0.2717，而总致癌风险（TCR）> 1 × 10^-4的概率分别为12.86%和3.38%。与生态风险不同，健康风险主要由自然地质成因源的Cr和Ni驱动，其次为U–As地球化学背景源中的As和混合人为源中的Pb。这些发现表明，生态和人体健康风险优先级在控制元素、源类别和风险加权路径上存在差异，而非仅受不同地球化学机制支配。因此，双背景和源导向的概率框架可以支持在受成土继承和扩散性人为输入影响的区域进行差异化的生态风险管理和人体健康风险预防。

articles.title_en: Apportioning groundwater sources in El-Gallaba Plain, Southwestern Desert, Egypt: A stable isotopes mixing model approach
articles.title_cn: 埃及西南沙漠埃尔加拉巴平原地下水来源的分配：稳定同位素混合模型方法
articles.abstract_en: Arid graben basins commonly host groundwater systems in which deep paleo-groundwater and younger surface-derived recharge interact through fault-controlled pathways, producing complex hydrochemical and isotopic signatures. El-Gallaba Plain, in West Kom Ombo City, Aswan Governorate, Egypt, in northeastern Africa, is a representative example of such a system and relies on groundwater as the main source of freshwater for agriculture and domestic use. This study investigates the relationship between the Quaternary aquifer and adjacent water sources, including the Nubian Aquifer (NA) and surface water (N + LN), using hydrochemical modeling, isotope analysis, and isotopic source apportionment. Piper and Gibbs diagrams indicate that Na–Cl, Ca–Mg–Cl, and Na–SO4 facies dominate, and that water–rock interaction is the main control on groundwater chemistry. PHREEQC results show that the Quaternary waters contain dissolved salts such as NaCl, Mg(HCO3)2, Na2SO4, NaHCO3, and Ca(HCO3)2, produced mainly by leaching and cation exchange. The TDS–δ18O relationship identifies three distinct water groups. Bayesian stable isotope mixing modeling (SIMMR) suggests that about 53% of recharge derives from mixed Nubian Aquifer water, with the remainder linked to surface water. These results show that groundwater evolution in El-Gallaba Plain is controlled by interaction between ancient regional groundwater and modern recharge through structurally connected pathways, offering a framework relevant to similar arid graben basins.
articles.abstract_cn: 干旱地堑盆地通常蕴藏地下水系统，其中深层古地下水与较年轻的表层补给通过断层控制的路径相互作用，产生复杂的水化学和同位素特征。埃及阿斯旺省西科姆翁博市的埃尔加拉巴平原是此类系统的典型代表，其依赖地下水作为农业和家庭用水的主要淡水来源。本研究利用水化学模拟、同位素分析和同位素来源分配，探讨了第四纪含水层与邻近水源（包括努比亚含水层（NA）和地表水（N + LN））之间的关系。Piper和Gibbs图表明，Na–Cl、Ca–Mg–Cl和Na–SO4水化学类型占主导，水-岩相互作用是地下水化学的主要控制因素。PHREEQC结果表明，第四纪水体含有溶解盐类，如NaCl、Mg(HCO3)2、Na2SO4、NaHCO3和Ca(HCO3)2，主要由淋滤和阳离子交换产生。TDS–δ18O关系识别出三个不同的水组。贝叶斯稳定同位素混合模型（SIMMR）表明，约53%的补给来自混合的努比亚含水层水，其余与地表水相关。这些结果表明，埃尔加拉巴平原的地下水演化受古老区域地下水与现代补给通过构造连通路径的相互作用控制，为类似干旱地堑盆地提供了相关框架。

articles.title_en: Bridging the semantic gap for zero-shot object counting with language-augmented pseudo-exemplars
articles.title_cn: 弥合零样本目标计数中的语义鸿沟：语言增强的伪示例方法
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Zero-shot Object Counting (ZSC) aims to estimate the number of objects in novel categories solely based on class names, without requiring any annotated examples. Although recent advances in vision-language models, such as CLIP, have significantly improved performance, existing approaches still suffer from a persistent semantic gap between global text embeddings and local visual representations, leading to biased or inconsistent counting in complex scenes. This discrepancy often results from the inability of coarse text features to capture fine-grained visual distinctions and contextual nuances. To address these limitations, we propose Language-augmented Pseudo-exemplars (LAPE), a novel and comprehensive ZSC framework that performs both coarse- and fine-grained cross-modal alignment through a unified and trainable architecture. Specifically, we first leverage a large language model to enrich textual semantics, generating diverse and context-aware descriptions that extend beyond simple class names. The query image features and these enhanced text features are then aligned across modalities. Subsequently, a sparse semantic projection mechanism maps the global text embedding onto a compact set of the most relevant visual features, synthesizing language-augmented pseudo-exemplar representations. These pseudo-exemplars, together with the enriched textual features, jointly guide a density regression head for precise spatial distribution estimation, effectively suppressing background noise and enhancing focus on discriminative regions. Extensive experiments on FSC-147 and cross-dataset benchmarks demonstrate that our approach substantially strengthens text-vision alignment and achieves state-of-the-art counting accuracy, showcasing strong generalization capability to unseen categories even in complex scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/WJWu20/LAPE .
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 零样本目标计数（ZSC）旨在仅基于类别名称估计新类别中对象的数量，无需任何标注示例。尽管视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）的最新进展显著提升了性能，现有方法仍面临全局文本嵌入与局部视觉表示之间持续存在的语义鸿沟，导致在复杂场景中出现有偏或不一致的计数结果。这种差异通常源于粗粒度文本特征无法捕捉细粒度的视觉区分和上下文细微差别。为解决这些局限，我们提出了语言增强的伪示例（LAPE），一种新颖且全面的ZSC框架，通过统一且可训练的结构执行粗粒度和细粒度的跨模态对齐。具体而言，我们首先利用大型语言模型丰富文本语义，生成超越简单类别名称的多样化和上下文感知描述。随后，查询图像特征与这些增强的文本特征在模态间进行对齐。接着，一种稀疏语义投影机制将全局文本嵌入映射到一组最相关的视觉特征上，合成语言增强的伪示例表示。这些伪示例与丰富的文本特征共同指导密度回归头进行精确的空间分布估计，有效抑制背景噪声并增强对判别区域的关注。在FSC-147和跨数据集基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著加强了文本-视觉对齐，并实现了最先进的计数精度，展示了在复杂场景中对未见类别的强大泛化能力。代码可在https://github.com/WJWu20/LAPE获取。

articles.title_en: Mineralogy and geochemistry of beach sediments in the Gulf of Mexico and Mexican Pacific: Implication for provenance
articles.title_cn: 墨西哥湾和墨西哥太平洋海滩沉积物的矿物学与地球化学：物源指示意义
articles.abstract_en: This study assesses the geochemical characteristics and provenance of sediments from four beaches in the Gulf of Mexico (Barra Norte and Mocambo) and Mexican Pacific coast (Puerto Chiapas and Acapulco). Major, trace, and rare earth element (REE) concentrations with textural parameters were analysed to identify the sediment provenance and its associated geodynamic processes. Grain-size analysis revealed marked textural differences, with the domination of coarse-grained sediments in Acapulco, medium-grained sediments in Puerto Chiapas, and fine-grained sediments in Mocambo and Barra Norte beaches. Quartz dominates the mineral assemblages in all beaches, although Puerto Chiapas and Mocambo sediments contain higher proportions of mafic minerals, Acapulco and Barra Norte exhibit predominantly of felsic assemblages. Major-element geochemistry reveals strong compositional contrasts among three beaches. Puerto Chiapas sediments are enriched in Fe2O3, MgO, Cr, V, and Ni, indicating intermediate to mafic provenance, whereas Acapulco sediments exhibit high SiO2 contents (84.6-87.4 wt %), consistent with felsic and compositionally mature sedimentary sources. In contrast, Barra Norte and Mocambo sediments are characterized by elevated CaO contents associated with carbonate input, as well as felsic and intermediate source rocks. The chondrite-normalized REE patterns show LREE enrichment in all samples. CIA and PIA values indicate overall low chemical weathering in the three beaches, with slightly higher alteration in Puerto Chiapas (CIA and PIA ≈ 57) compared to Acapulco, Mocambo, and Barra Norte beaches (CIA and PIA ≈ 41-49), reflecting the preservation of relatively unaltered feldspars. Elemental ratios like Al2O3/TiO2, Cr and Ni contents, and the size of the Eu anomaly suggest a felsic source for the Acapulco, and Barra Norte sediments, whereas Mocambo and Puerto Chiapas sediments reflect intermediate provenance with minor mafic contributions. The geoaccumulation index (Igeo) and enrichment factor (EF) indicate that the beach sediments are practically uncontaminated (Igeo < 0; EF < 2), except a moderate enrichment is observed for Co, Zn, and V in some Puerto Chiapas samples, collected near to the seaport. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) results indicate that major and trace elements variability is partly controlled by grain-size and heavy-minerals, while REE distributions are independent of grain size. The results of this study further indicate a diverse provenance, with contributions from mafic to intermediate source rocks for the Puerto Chiapas and Mocambo, and predominantly felsic source rocks for the Acapulco and Barra Norte beaches. These findings demonstrate that sediment geochemistry along the Mexican coastal areas is primarily controlled by source-rock lithology, regional tectonic setting, and hydrodynamic sorting.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了墨西哥湾（巴拉诺特和莫坎博）和墨西哥太平洋沿岸（恰帕斯港和阿卡普尔科）四个海滩沉积物的地球化学特征和物源。分析了主量元素、微量元素和稀土元素（REE）浓度以及粒度参数，以识别沉积物物源及其相关的地球动力学过程。粒度分析揭示了显著的粒度差异，阿卡普尔科以粗粒沉积物为主，恰帕斯港以中粒沉积物为主，而莫坎博和巴拉诺特海滩以细粒沉积物为主。所有海滩的矿物组合中石英占主导，尽管恰帕斯港和莫坎博沉积物含有较高比例的铁镁质矿物，阿卡普尔科和巴拉诺特则主要显示长英质组合。主量元素地球化学揭示了三个海滩之间的强烈成分对比。恰帕斯港沉积物富含Fe2O3、MgO、Cr、V和Ni，指示中基性物源，而阿卡普尔科沉积物显示出高SiO2含量（84.6-87.4 wt%），与长英质和成分成熟的沉积来源一致。相比之下，巴拉诺特和莫坎博沉积物的特征是CaO含量升高，与碳酸盐输入以及长英质和中酸性源岩有关。球粒陨石标准化REE模式显示所有样品中轻稀土富集。CIA和PIA值表明三个海滩总体化学风化程度较低，恰帕斯港的蚀变程度略高（CIA和PIA约57），而阿卡普尔科、莫坎博和巴拉诺特海滩（CIA和PIA约41-49），反映了相对未蚀变长石的保存。元素比值如Al2O3/TiO2、Cr和Ni含量以及Eu异常大小表明阿卡普尔科和巴拉诺特沉积物为长英质来源，而莫坎博和恰帕斯港沉积物反映中酸性物源并伴有少量铁镁质贡献。地质累积指数（Igeo）和富集因子（EF）表明海滩沉积物实际上未受污染（Igeo < 0；EF < 2），除了在靠近港口的某些恰帕斯港样品中观察到Co、Zn和V的中等富集。主成分分析（PCA）结果表明，主量元素和微量元素的变化部分受粒度和重矿物控制，而REE分布与粒度无关。本研究结果进一步表明物源多样，恰帕斯港和莫坎博有来自基性到中酸性源岩的贡献，而阿卡普尔科和巴拉诺特海滩主要为长英质源岩。这些发现表明，墨西哥沿海地区的沉积物地球化学主要受源岩岩性、区域构造背景和水动力分选控制。

articles.title_en: Online rheological perception of fresh cementitious material toward intelligent construction: An energy transfer analysis approach
articles.title_cn: 面向智能建造的新拌胶凝材料流变学在线感知：一种能量传递分析方法
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. Existing rheological testing methods for cementitious materials are either straightforward but information-limited or complex and time-consuming, making them inadequate for intelligent construction. This study proposes an energy-transfer analysis approach based on gravity-wave characteristics, enabling rapid rheological identification via non-contact optical sensing. Gravity waves were generated by impacting a rod on cement paste at ten hydration ages (15–150 min), and the resulting surface height variations were precisely measured using a laser profiler. Energy transfer efficiency (ETE) and wave slope (WS) were extracted to quantify wave energy conversion and calibrated against rotational rheometer measurements using the Modified Bingham (MB) and Herschel-Bulkley (HB) models. ETE and WS showed strong correlations with rheological parameters and captured their hydration-dependent evolution. The established identification model achieved accuracies of 94.3 ± 0.7% and 82.0 ± 4.1% for MB and HB models, respectively. Uncertainty propagation further demonstrated the greater robustness of MB-based identification, with a much narrower 95% bootstrap CI than HB-based identification. Energy dissipation physics were found to be consistent with the exponential attenuation of macroscopic waves. This sampling-free method provides theoretical support for online real-time rheological monitoring of cementitious materials.

articles.title_en: Integration of automated experiment and domain adaptation for precise evaluation of cement dispersant performance
articles.title_cn: 自动化实验与域适应的集成用于水泥分散剂性能的精确评估
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. Evaluating the rheological performance of modern concrete requires large datasets due to the diversity of mixture compositions and the inherent variability of cementitious materials. Our previous study introduced automated experimentation for high-throughput rheological measurement of cement-based materials. In this study, the system is extended to enable reliable estimation of Bingham parameters by integrating domain adaptation. A total of 100 mortar samples with systematically varied mix proportions were tested using the proposed framework. The resulting large, high-quality dataset, combined with machine learning, enables accurate estimation of Bingham parameters that are consistent with the measured torque response. Shapley additive explanations further confirm the proposed approach provides physically reasonable Bingham parameter estimates. The proposed system demonstrates its applicability to PCE performance evaluation, detection of subtle variations in rheological behavior, and quantitative assessment toward rheological standardization. Through this work, an automated experimentation platform for rheological characterization of cement-based materials has been completed, establishing a methodological transition toward data-centric concrete rheology.

articles.title_en: Adenoid hypertrophy is associated with poorer outcomes of acute mastoiditis in children
articles.title_cn: 腺样体肥大与儿童急性乳突炎预后较差相关
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Introduction: Acute mastoiditis is one of the most common complication of acute otitis media, and its clinical course may vary significantly among patients. Objective: To investigate the association between adenoid size and the severity of acute mastoiditis in children. Methods: This retrospective cohort study included children (<18 years) hospitalized with acute mastoiditis. The primary outcome was the association between disease severity—defined by the presence of intracranial complications or PICU admission - and the adenoid-to-nasopharyngeal ratio (ANR), measured on CT scans at three nasopharyngeal levels. Secondary outcomes included length of hospital stay, differences in bacterial profiles, and incidence of subsequent ear infections. Results: A total of 106 children (64 males [60.3%], mean age 3.03 years [IQR: 1–3.9]) were included in the analysis, of whom 32 (30.2%) were classified as having severe disease. Patients with severe mastoiditis were younger, had higher CRP levels, a longer duration of fever before presentation, underwent mastoidectomy more frequently, and had longer hospital stays (all p < 0.05). The ANR was significantly higher in patients with severe disease (0.6 vs. 0.4, p = 0.01).
